summary.en:
A general-purpose container whose padding, surface, radius and border all come from tokens. Use it when you
need an area with a background that is not a full panel.
summary.zh: 通用容器：内边距、表面、圆角、描边都取令牌。需要一块有底色的区域但又不是完整面板时使用。

usage.en: Local background blocks, scrollable areas, padding around a group of content
usage.zh: 局部底色块、可滚动区域、给一组内容加内边距

description.en: Padding on all sides, as a spacing step.
description.zh: 四周内边距档位。

description.en: Horizontal padding, as a spacing step (overrides the left and right of `padding`).
description.zh: 横向内边距档位（覆盖 padding 的左右）。

description.en: Vertical padding, as a spacing step (overrides the top and bottom of `padding`).
description.zh: 纵向内边距档位（覆盖 padding 的上下）。

description.en:
Background surface: `canvas`, `surface` (panel), `sunken` (input backgrounds, table headers) or `elevated`
(overlays).
description.zh: 背景表面：canvas 画布、surface 面板、sunken 凹陷（输入底、表头）、elevated 浮层。

description.en: Corner radius step.
description.zh: 圆角档位。

description.en:
Shows a hairline border. Hierarchy comes from backgrounds: separate blocks with `surface`, and use a border
only where an outline is really needed, such as drop zones and placeholders.
description.zh: 显示一圈发丝描边。层次靠底色：区分区块用 `surface`，描边只用于拖放区、占位框等确实需要轮廓的场景。

description.en: Takes up the remaining space in a parent Stack or Inline.
description.zh: 在父级 Stack / Inline 中占满剩余空间。

description.en: Scrolls inside this container when the content overflows.
description.zh: 内容超出时在本容器内滚动。

description.en: HTML element to render.
description.zh: 输出的 HTML 元素。

description.en: Content.
description.zh: 内容。

examples.name: Basic

description.en: A block with a background, rounded corners and padding.
description.zh: 有底色、圆角和内边距的区块。

examples.name: Surfaces

summary.en: Centers its content horizontally and vertically in the available space.
summary.zh: 把内容在可用空间中水平、垂直居中。

usage.en: Empty states, loading indicators and placeholder notes for a whole page or area
usage.zh: 整页或整块区域的空状态、加载指示、占位说明

description.en: Fills the height of the parent container (such as a full-page empty state).
description.zh: 占满父容器的高度（如整页空状态）。

description.en: Padding on all sides, as a spacing step.
description.zh: 四周内边距档位。

description.en: Content.
description.zh: 内容。

examples.name: Basic

description.en: Shows a hint centered in an area.
description.zh: 在区域中居中显示提示。

summary.en:
A divider that separates content at the same level, optionally with text (such as date separators in a message
list). Prefer spacing and backgrounds to express hierarchy; use a divider only when a line is really needed.
summary.zh: 分隔线：分隔同一层级中的内容，可带文字（如消息列表的日期分隔）。层次优先用间距与底色区分，只有确实需要一条线时才用它。

usage.en: Date separators in message lists, groups in menus and lists
usage.zh: 消息列表的日期分隔、菜单与列表中的分组

examples.name: Basic

description.en: Separate levels with spacing and backgrounds first; use a divider only when a line is really needed.
description.zh: 层次优先用间距与底色区分，确实需要一条线时才用分隔线。

examples.name: WithText

description.en: Date separators in a message list.
description.zh: 消息列表的日期分隔。

summary.en:
Arranges children in a grid, with a fixed number of columns or filled automatically by a minimum column width.
Use it for card walls, grids of entry points and two-column forms.
summary.zh: 网格排列：固定列数，或按最小列宽自动填充。卡片墙、入口宫格、表单两栏都用它。

usage.en: Card grids, grids of entry points on a home page, two- or three-column forms
usage.zh: 卡片网格、首页入口宫格、两栏或三栏表单

description.en:
Fixed number of columns; when omitted, columns are filled automatically by `minColumn` (responsive to the
width).
description.zh: 固定列数；不传则按 `minColumn` 自动填充（响应宽度变化）。

description.en: Minimum column width when filling automatically: `sm` 160 px, `md` 240 px, `lg` 320 px.
description.zh: 自动填充时每列的最小宽度档位：sm 160px、md 240px、lg 320px。

description.en: Space between rows and columns, as a spacing step.
description.zh: 行列间距档位。

description.en: Padding on all sides, as a spacing step; no padding when omitted.
description.zh: 四周内边距档位；不传则没有内边距。

description.en: HTML element to render.
description.zh: 输出的 HTML 元素。

description.en: Content.
description.zh: 内容。

examples.name: Basic

description.en:
Without a number of columns, the grid fills the row automatically by minimum column width (`md`, 240 px, by
default).
description.zh: 不指定列数时按最小列宽（默认 md 240px）自动填充。

examples.name: TwoColumns

description.en: Use a fixed number of columns for two-column forms and details.
description.zh: 表单两栏、详情两栏用固定列数。

summary.en:
Lays out children horizontally, vertically centered by default. Use it for toolbars, button groups and
"icon + text" combinations.
summary.zh: 横向排列子元素，默认垂直居中。工具栏、按钮组、「图标 + 文字」组合都用它。

usage.en: Buttons, tags, icons and text side by side; with a Spacer, pushing the rest to the right
usage.zh: 横向排列按钮、标签、图标与文字；配合 Spacer 把后面的元素推到右侧

description.en: Space between children, as a spacing step.
description.zh: 子元素之间的间距档位。

description.en: Padding on all sides, as a spacing step; no padding when omitted.
description.zh: 四周内边距档位；不传则没有内边距。

description.en: Vertical alignment of the children.
description.zh: 子元素在纵向上的对齐。

description.en: Horizontal distribution of the children; `between` pushes the first and last children to the two ends.
description.zh: 子元素在横向上的分布；`between` 把首尾元素推到两端。

description.en: Wraps onto new lines when there is not enough space (groups of tags or buttons).
description.zh: 空间不足时换行（标签组、按钮组）。

description.en: Takes up the remaining space in a parent Stack or Inline.
description.zh: 在父级 Stack / Inline 中占满剩余空间。

description.en: HTML element to render.
description.zh: 输出的 HTML 元素。

description.en: Content.
description.zh: 内容。

examples.name: Basic

description.en: Arranges children in a row, vertically centered, with spacing step 2 by default.
description.zh: 横向排列，默认垂直居中、间距档位 2。

examples.name: WithSpacer

title.en: Title row with both ends aligned

description.en: Spacer pushes the action button to the right.
description.zh: 用 Spacer 把操作按钮推到右侧。

examples.name: Wrapping

description.en: Wraps when there is not enough space.
description.zh: 空间不足时换行。

summary.en:
Flexible space that fills the remaining space in an Inline or Stack and pushes the following elements to the
other end.
summary.zh: 弹性空白：在 Inline / Stack 中占满剩余空间，把后面的元素推到另一端。

usage.en: Pushing the action buttons of a toolbar to the right
usage.zh: 工具栏里把操作按钮推到右侧

examples.name: Basic

description.en: Pushes the following elements to the right inside an Inline.
description.zh: 在 Inline 中把后面的元素推到右侧。

summary.en:
Lays out children vertically, with spacing from the token steps. Use it to stack page blocks, form groups and
drawer content.
summary.zh: 纵向排列子元素，间距取令牌档位。页面区块、表单分组、抽屉内容都用它堆叠。

usage.en: Stacking blocks, form fields and lists vertically; replaces hand-written layout classes and layout CSS
usage.zh: 纵向堆叠区块、表单项、列表；替代手写的布局类与布局 CSS

description.en: Space between children, as a spacing step.
description.zh: 子元素之间的间距档位。

description.en: Padding on all sides, as a spacing step; no padding when omitted.
description.zh: 四周内边距档位；不传则没有内边距。

description.en: Horizontal alignment of the children.
description.zh: 子元素在横向上的对齐。

description.en: Vertical distribution of the children (takes effect when the container has spare height).
description.zh: 子元素在纵向上的分布（父容器有剩余高度时生效）。

description.en: Takes up the remaining space in a parent Stack or Inline.
description.zh: 在父级 Stack / Inline 中占满剩余空间。

description.en: Scrolls inside this container when the content overflows (and lets the container shrink).
description.zh: 内容超出时在本容器内滚动（同时允许本容器被压缩）。

description.en: HTML element to render, for semantics (`ul` / `li` for lists, `section` for page regions, and so on).
description.zh: 输出的 HTML 元素，用于语义（列表用 ul/li，页面区域用 section 等）。

description.en: Content.
description.zh: 内容。

examples.name: Basic

description.en: Vertical arrangement with a default gap of step 3 (12 px).
description.zh: 纵向排列，默认间距档位 3（12px）。

examples.code:
export function Basic() {
  return (
    <Stack>
      <Box surface="sunken" radius="md" padding={3}>
        First block
      </Box>
      <Box surface="sunken" radius="md" padding={3}>
        Second block
      </Box>
      <Box surface="sunken" radius="md" padding={3}>
        Third block
      </Box>
    </Stack>
  )
}

examples.name: Gaps

description.en: Gaps only take steps 0–8, consistent across the application.
description.zh: 间距只能取 0–8 档位，与整个应用一致。

examples.code:
export function Gaps() {
  return (
    <Stack gap={5}>
      <Stack gap={1}>
        <Text weight="semibold">Title</Text>
        <Text tone="secondary" size="sm">
          A description right below its title uses step 1
        </Text>
      </Stack>
      <Stack gap={1}>
        <Text weight="semibold">Another group</Text>
        <Text tone="secondary" size="sm">
          The two groups are separated by step 5
        </Text>
      </Stack>
    </Stack>
  )
}

examples.name: FormGroup

description.en: Step 4 between form fields, the button at the bottom aligned to the right.
description.zh: 表单项之间档位 4，底部按钮右对齐。

summary.en:
Text with consistent font size, weight, tone, monospace and truncation. Use it for body text, descriptions,
IDs, times and group headings.
summary.zh: 文字：统一字号、字重、色调、等宽与省略。正文、说明、编号、时间、分组小标题都用它。

usage.en: Secondary text, IDs and paths (`mono`), amounts and times (`numeric`), truncation, group headings (`overline`)
usage.zh: 次要说明文字、编号与路径（mono）、金额与时间（numeric）、单行省略、分组小标题（overline）

description.en: Font size step: `2xs` 11, `xs` 12, `sm` 13, `md` 14, `lg` 16, `xl` 20 px.
description.zh: 字号档位：2xs 11、xs 12、sm 13、md 14、lg 16、xl 20px。

description.en:
Font weight step: `regular` for body text, `medium` for emphasis, `semibold` for labels and small headings,
`bold` for figures and key points.
description.zh: 字重档位：regular 正文、medium 强调、semibold 标签与小标题、bold 数字与重点。

description.en:
Tone: `primary` for main text, `secondary` for supporting text, `tertiary` for faint hints; the others are
semantic colors.
description.zh: 色调：primary 主要文字、secondary 次要说明、tertiary 弱提示，其余为语义色。

description.en: Monospace font: IDs, code, API names, paths.
description.zh: 等宽字体：编号、代码、接口名、路径。

description.en: Tabular numbers (without changing the font), so that amounts, quantities and times line up vertically.
description.zh: 等宽数字（不换字体），用于金额、数量、时间的纵向对齐。

description.en: Truncates overflowing text: `true` for a single line, a number for the maximum number of lines.
description.zh: 超出时省略：`true` 为单行，数字为最多显示的行数。

description.en: Overline style for group headings (small, secondary color, wider letter spacing).
description.zh: 分组小标题样式（小号、次要色、加字距）。

description.en: HTML element to render: `p` for paragraphs, `label` for form labels.
description.zh: 输出的 HTML 元素：段落用 p，表单标签用 label。

description.en: ID of the associated form control when `as="label"`.
description.zh: `as="label"` 时关联的表单控件 ID。

description.en: Machine-readable time when `as="time"`.
description.zh: `as="time"` 时的机器可读时间。

description.en: Full text shown on mouse hover (often used together with `truncate`).
description.zh: 鼠标悬停时显示的完整文本（常与 truncate 一起用）。

description.en: Text content.
description.zh: 文字内容。

examples.name: Basic

description.en: Body text, secondary descriptions and faint hints.
description.zh: 正文、次要说明与弱提示。

examples.name: MonoAndNumeric

description.en: Codes and paths use the monospace font; amounts, quantities and times use tabular numbers to align vertically.
description.zh: 编号和路径用等宽字体；金额、数量、时间用等宽数字纵向对齐。

examples.name: Overline
Truncate

description.en: Truncated to one line; the full text is shown on hover.
description.zh: 单行省略，悬停显示完整文本。

summary.en:
AutoComplete is a text input that suggests values while typing; unlike Select, any text can be entered. Provide
the suggestions with `options`, usually filtered in `onSearch`.

**Interaction**: filled input like Input. Suggestions open while typing; `↑` / `↓` move the highlight, `Enter`
fills in the highlighted suggestion and `Esc` closes the list without changing the text. Focus stays in the
input.
summary.zh:
自动补全：输入时给出建议的文本输入框；与 Select 不同，可以输入任意文字。建议用 `options` 给出，通常在
`onSearch` 中过滤。

**交互**：与 Input 一样是填充式。输入时展开建议；`↑` / `↓` 移动高亮，`Enter` 填入高亮的建议，`Esc` 收起建议而不改变文字。焦点始终在输入框中。

usage.en: Email addresses and domains, tags, search with suggestions
usage.zh: 邮箱地址与域名、标签、带建议的搜索

description.en: The suggestions, usually filtered in `onSearch`.
description.zh: 建议，通常在 `onSearch` 中筛选。

description.en: Current text (controlled).
description.zh: 当前文字（受控）。

description.en: Initial text (uncontrolled).
description.zh: 初始文字（非受控）。

description.en: Called with the new text, when typing or choosing a suggestion.
description.zh: 文字变化时调用，包括输入与选择建议。

description.en: Called with the typed text, to update the suggestions.
description.zh: 输入文字时调用，用于更新建议。

description.en: Called when a suggestion is chosen.
description.zh: 选择一个建议时调用。

description.en:
Filters the suggestions by the typed text: `true` keeps those that contain it (ignoring case), or a function.
Leave it out when `onSearch` already filters them.
description.zh: 按输入的文字筛选建议：`true` 保留包含它的建议（不区分大小写），也可以是函数。在 `onSearch` 中已经筛选时省略。

description.en: Text shown while the field is empty.
description.zh: 框为空时显示的文字。

description.en: Shows a clear button while the field has text.
description.zh: 有文字时显示清除按钮。

description.en: Disables the field.
description.zh: 禁用。

description.en: Fills the width of the container.
description.zh: 占满容器的宽度。

description.en: Size: `sm` in table rows and toolbars, `lg` for prominent forms. Without it, the size follows the density.
description.zh: 尺寸：`sm` 用于表格行内与工具栏，`lg` 用于醒目的表单。省略时随密度。

description.en: Appearance: `filled` (neutral background, the default) or `borderless`.
description.zh: 外观：`filled` 填充式（中性底，默认）或 `borderless` 无底色。

description.en: Validation status, usually set by Form.Item.
description.zh: 校验状态，通常由 Form.Item 设置。

description.en: Id of the input element, so that a `<label for>` can point to it (Form.Item sets it).
description.zh: 输入元素的 id，供 `<label for>` 指向（Form.Item 会设置）。

description.en: Accessible name, when there is no visible label.
description.zh: 读屏名称，没有可见的标签时提供。

description.en: Id of the element that labels the input.
description.zh: 作为标签的元素的 id。

description.en: Id of the element that describes the input, such as a hint.
description.zh: 说明这个输入的元素（如提示文字）的 id。

description.en: Test id, output as `data-testid`.
description.zh: 测试定位，输出为 `data-testid`。

description.en: Focuses the input when it mounts.
description.zh: 挂载时聚焦。

description.en: Called when the input gets the focus.
description.zh: 获得焦点时调用。

description.en: Called when the input loses the focus.
description.zh: 失去焦点时调用。

description.en: Called on key presses in the input.
description.zh: 在输入框中按键时调用。

examples.name: Basic

description.en: Suggests complete email addresses while typing; any text can still be entered.
description.zh: 输入时建议完整的邮箱地址；仍然可以输入任意文字。

examples.name: Fixed

description.en: Filter fixed options with `filterOption`.
description.zh: 用 `filterOption` 过滤固定的选项。

summary.en:
A letter avatar showing the first character of a name. The name picks one of five tones (blue, green, orange,
purple, cyan) in a stable way (light background with dark text, dark background with light text in dark mode),
without a border; with an icon instead of text, the background is a neutral fill. It can have an accent ring
and a status badge at the bottom right. The avatar itself is hidden from screen readers (the name is usually
shown next to it); only the status badge is announced.
summary.zh: 头像：取名称首字的字母头像。按名称稳定地取蓝、绿、橙、紫、青五种色调之一（浅底深字，深色模式为暗底浅字），不描边；以图标代替文字时用中性填充底。可加强调色外环，可在右下角显示状态角标。头像本身对读屏隐藏（名称一般已显示在旁边），只有状态角标会被读出。

usage.en: Avatars of conversations, teams and projects; `leading` of list items; account menus; online status
usage.zh: 会话、团队、项目的头像；列表行的 leading；账户菜单；带在线状态的成员头像

description.en:
Person's or item's name: the first character is shown, and the whole name determines the tone in a stable
way (the same name has the same color everywhere).
description.zh: 姓名或名称：取第一个字符显示，并按整个名称稳定地决定色调（同一名称在各处颜色相同）。

description.en: Size in pixels: commonly 20 (tables, tags), 28 (sidebars) or 32 (lists).
description.zh: 像素尺寸：常用 20（表格、标签）、28（侧栏）、32（列表）。

description.en: Accent ring, for avatars that need to stand out, such as teams or the current user.
description.zh: 强调色外环：团队、当前用户等需要突出的头像。

description.en: Shows an icon instead of text (such as system notifications), on a neutral fill without a tone.
description.zh: 以图标代替文字（如系统通知），底色为中性填充，不取色调。

description.en: Status badge at the bottom right (a StatusDot tone), such as online status; not shown when omitted.
description.zh: 右下角的状态角标（StatusDot 的色调），如在线状态；不传则不显示。

description.en: Accessible name of the status badge, such as "Online"; the default name of the tone is used when omitted.
description.zh: 状态角标的读屏名称，如「在线」；不传时用色调的默认名称。

examples.name: Basic

description.en:
Shows the first character of the name and picks one of five tones from the name, so the same name has the same
color everywhere. Common sizes are 20, 28 and 32.
description.zh: 取名称首字，按名称稳定地取五种色调之一（同一名称在各处颜色相同）；尺寸常用 20、28、32。

examples.name: RingAndIcon

description.en:
`ring` adds an accent ring for avatars that should stand out, such as teams or the current user; `icon` shows an
icon instead of text (for example, system notifications) on a neutral fill.
description.zh: `ring` 加强调色外环，用于团队、当前用户等需要突出的头像；`icon` 以图标代替文字（如系统通知），底色为中性填充。

examples.name: WithStatus

description.en: `status` takes a tone of StatusDot and appears at the bottom right; `statusLabel` is its accessible name.
description.zh: `status` 取 StatusDot 的色调，显示在右下角；`statusLabel` 是读屏名称。

summary.en:
Breadcrumb shows where the current page is in the hierarchy and links to its parent pages. Use it on detail
pages several levels deep; the page title stays in the page header.

**Interaction**: links and buttons in the path are secondary text; hover adds the state layer, and `Tab` focus
shows the focus ring. The last item is the current page (`aria-current="page"`) and is not interactive. An item
with `menu` opens its dropdown menu on click or `Enter`, like Dropdown: focus moves into the menu and returns to
the item after closing.
summary.zh:
面包屑：显示当前页面在层级中的位置，并链接到上级页面。用于层级较深的详情页；页面标题仍放在页面头中。

**交互**：路径中的链接与按钮为次要文字色，悬停叠加状态层，`Tab` 聚焦显示焦点环。最后一项是当前页（`aria-current="page"`），不可交互。带 `menu` 的项点击或按 `Enter` 弹出下拉菜单，与 Dropdown 相同：焦点进入菜单，关闭后回到该项。

usage.en: Folder paths, the parent pages of a detail page, settings subpages
usage.zh: 文件夹路径、详情页的上级页面、设置子页面

description.en:
The path from the top level to the current page; the last item is the current page and is not a link. Items
with `href` are links; items with only `onClick` are rendered as buttons; items with `menu` are buttons that open
a dropdown menu (such as sibling folders).
description.zh: 从顶层到当前页面的路径；最后一项是当前页，不是链接。带 `href` 的项是链接；只有 `onClick` 的项渲染为按钮；带 `menu` 的项是打开下拉菜单（如同级文件夹）的按钮。

description.en: Accessible name of the navigation landmark; the built-in text by default ("Breadcrumb").
description.zh: 导航区域的读屏名称，默认为内置文本（「面包屑」）。

examples.name: Basic

description.en: The path from the top level to the current page; the last item is the current page and is not a link.
description.zh: 从顶层到当前页面的路径；最后一项是当前页，不是链接。

examples.name: Variants

description.en:
Items with only `onClick` are rendered as buttons (for navigation inside the application); `menu` opens a
dropdown menu with sibling pages.
description.zh: 只有 `onClick` 的项渲染为按钮（用于应用内导航）；`menu` 弹出同级页面的下拉菜单。

summary.en:
Buttons trigger an action. Use `variant="primary"` for the primary action (at most one per area), add
`tone="danger"` for destructive actions, and use the default style for secondary actions. For accent-colored
text actions in table rows, on cards and next to body text, use LinkButton.

**Interaction**: hover and press change the color according to the theme tokens (press takes effect
immediately and recovers 120 ms after release, without scaling); `Tab` focus shows the focus ring, and
`Enter` / `Space` trigger the button. While `loading`, the width stays the same and clicks are ignored: a button
with an icon replaces the icon with the loading indicator, a button without an icon keeps its text in place but
hidden, with the loading indicator centered. While `disabled`, it does not respond; with `disabledReason`, the
reason is shown on hover or focus.
summary.zh:
按钮。主操作用 `variant="primary"`（每个区域最多一个），危险操作加 `tone="danger"`，次要操作用默认样式。表格行内、卡片上与正文并排的强调色文字操作用 LinkButton。

**交互**：悬停、按下按主题令牌变色（按下立即生效，松开 120ms 恢复，不缩放）；`Tab` 聚焦显示焦点环，
`Enter` / `Space` 触发。`loading` 时宽度不变、忽略点击：有图标的把图标换成加载指示，没有图标的文字保持占位但隐藏，加载指示居中。`disabled` 时不响应，提供 `disabledReason` 时悬停或聚焦显示原因。

usage.en: Primary action of a page header, form submission, confirming a dialog
usage.zh: 页面头的主操作、表单提交、弹窗确认

description.en:
Appearance: `primary` for the main action (solid accent color, at most one per area), `default` for
secondary actions (neutral fill), `dashed` for adding something to a list, `text` for a neutral text button
(a background appears on hover). For accent-colored text links, use LinkButton.
description.zh:
外观：`primary` 主操作（强调色实心，每个区域最多一个），`default` 次要操作（中性填充），`dashed`
向列表添加内容，`text` 中性文字按钮（悬停出现底色）。强调色的文字链接用 LinkButton。

description.en: Semantic color: `danger` for destructive actions such as deleting; combine it with any `variant`.
description.zh: 语义色：`danger` 用于删除等危险操作，可以与任意 `variant` 组合。

description.en: Size: `sm` in table rows and toolbars, `lg` for prominent forms. Without it, the size follows the density.
description.zh: 尺寸：`sm` 用于表格行内与工具栏，`lg` 用于醒目的表单。省略时随密度。

description.en: Icon before the text, usually `<Icon name="…" />`. For a button with only an icon, use IconButton.
description.zh: 文字前的图标，通常是 `<Icon name="…" />`。只有图标的按钮用 IconButton。

description.en: Shows a loading indicator and ignores clicks; the width stays the same.
description.zh: 显示加载指示并忽略点击，宽度不变。

description.en: Stretches the button to the width of its container.
description.zh: 占满容器的宽度。

description.en:
Native button type: `submit` submits the enclosing form, `reset` resets it. The default is `button`, which
does neither (unlike a bare `<button>`).
description.zh: 原生按钮类型：`submit` 提交所在的表单，`reset` 重置表单。默认 `button`，两者都不做（与裸 `<button>` 不同）。

description.en: Turns the button into a link to this address (rendered as `<a>`).
description.zh: 把按钮变成指向这个地址的链接（输出为 `<a>`）。

description.en: Where the link opens, such as `_blank`; only with `href`.
description.zh: 链接在哪里打开，如 `_blank`；只在有 `href` 时有效。

description.en: Downloads the linked file instead of opening it; a string sets the file name. Only with `href`.
description.zh: 下载链接指向的文件而不是打开它；是字符串时作为文件名。只在有 `href` 时有效。

description.en:
Disabled reason: an explanation shown on hover or keyboard focus while `disabled`, such as "You don't have
permission to delete" or "Select a file first". With a reason, the button can still be focused with `Tab`
(`aria-disabled`) and screen readers read the reason through `aria-describedby`; clicks, `Enter`, form
submission (`type="submit"`) and link navigation have no effect.
description.zh: 禁用原因：`disabled` 时悬停或键盘聚焦显示的说明，如「没有删除权限」「请先选择文件」。提供后按钮仍可用 Tab 聚焦（`aria-disabled`），读屏通过 `aria-describedby` 读出原因；点击、回车、表单提交（`type="submit"`）与链接跳转都不会生效。

description.en: Button text.
description.zh: 按钮文字。

description.en: The rendered `<button>` (or `<a>` with `href`).
description.zh: 渲染出的 `<button>`（有 `href` 时是 `<a>`）。

examples.name: Basic

description.en: At most one primary button per area; add `tone="danger"` for destructive actions.
description.zh: 每个区域最多一个主按钮；危险操作加 danger。

examples.name: States

description.en:
Show `loading` while submitting to prevent double submission. The width does not change while loading: a button
with an icon replaces the icon with the loading indicator; a button without one hides its text and centers the
indicator.
description.zh: 提交中显示 loading，防止重复提交。加载时宽度不变：有图标的把图标换成加载指示，没有图标的文字隐藏、指示居中。

examples.name: LoadOnClick

description.en:
Clicks are ignored while loading and the width of the button stays the same, so the content next to it does not
move.
description.zh: 加载期间忽略点击，按钮宽度不变，旁边的内容不会跳动。

examples.name: DisabledReason

description.en:
When a button is disabled because of permissions or unmet conditions, explain why with `disabledReason`: it
appears on hover or keyboard focus, and screen readers read it too.
description.zh: 因权限或条件不满足而禁用时，用 disabledReason 说明原因：悬停或键盘聚焦时显示，读屏也能读到。

examples.code:
export function DisabledReason() {
  return (
    <Inline>
      <Button
        variant="primary"
        tone="danger"
        disabled
        disabledReason="You do not have permission to delete. Contact an administrator."
      >
        Delete project
      </Button>
      <Button disabled disabledReason="Select a file first">
        Download
      </Button>
    </Inline>
  )
}

summary.en:
Cascader picks a value from options nested in several levels, such as region → city → district or category →
subcategory; each level opens in its own column. Add `showSearch` to search across all levels, and `multiple` for
several values.

**Interaction**: filled input like Select. `↓` or `Enter` opens the columns; `↑` / `↓` move within a column,
`→` opens the next level and `←` goes back; `Enter` picks the highlighted option; `Esc` closes the columns. Focus
stays in the input.
summary.zh:
级联选择：从多层嵌套的选项中选择，如地区 → 城市 → 区县、分类 → 子分类，每一层在单独的一列中展开。`showSearch`
跨层级搜索，`multiple` 多选。

**交互**：与 Select 一样是填充式。`↓` 或 `Enter` 展开；`↑` / `↓` 在列内移动，`→` 展开下一层，`←` 返回上一层；
`Enter` 选中高亮的选项；`Esc` 收起。焦点始终在输入框中。

usage.en: Regions and addresses, nested categories, choosing a folder by path
usage.zh: 地区与地址、多级分类、按路径选择文件夹

description.en: Allows choosing several options; the value becomes an array of paths.
description.zh: 可以选择多个选项，值变为路径的数组。

description.en:
With `multiple`: when all children of an option are chosen, show only the `parent` or only the `child`
options.
When all children of an option are chosen, show only the `parent` (the default) or only the `child` options.
description.zh: 与 `multiple` 一起使用：某个选项的子选项全部选中时，只显示父选项（`parent`）或只显示子选项（`child`）。

description.en:
Path of the chosen option, from the first level (controlled), such as `['asia', 'cn', 'shanghai']`.
Paths of the chosen options (controlled).
description.zh: 所选选项的路径，从第一级开始（受控），如 `['asia', 'cn', 'shanghai']`。

description.en:
Initial path (uncontrolled).
Initial paths (uncontrolled).
description.zh: 初始路径（非受控）。

description.en:
Called with the new path; `undefined` when cleared.
Called with the new paths.
description.zh: 路径变化时调用；清除时为 `undefined`。

description.en: The options of the first level.
description.zh: 第一级的选项。

description.en: Text shown while nothing is chosen.
description.zh: 没有选择时显示的文字。

description.en: Lets the user type to search across all levels.
description.zh: 可以输入文字在所有层级中搜索。

description.en: Shows a clear button while something is chosen.
description.zh: 有选择时显示清除按钮。

description.en: Disables the field.
description.zh: 禁用。

description.en: Fills the width of the container.
description.zh: 占满容器的宽度。

description.en: Size: `sm` in table rows and toolbars, `lg` for prominent forms. Without it, the size follows the density.
description.zh: 尺寸：`sm` 用于表格行内与工具栏，`lg` 用于醒目的表单。省略时随密度。

description.en: Appearance: `filled` (neutral background, the default) or `borderless`.
description.zh: 外观：`filled` 填充式（中性底，默认）或 `borderless` 无底色。

description.en: Validation status, usually set by Form.Item.
description.zh: 校验状态，通常由 Form.Item 设置。

description.en: Id of the input element, so that a `<label for>` can point to it (Form.Item sets it).
description.zh: 输入元素的 id，供 `<label for>` 指向（Form.Item 会设置）。

description.en: Accessible name, when there is no visible label.
description.zh: 读屏名称，没有可见的标签时提供。

description.en: Id of the element that labels the input.
description.zh: 作为标签的元素的 id。

description.en: Id of the element that describes the input, such as a hint.
description.zh: 说明这个输入的元素（如提示文字）的 id。

description.en: Test id, output as `data-testid`.
description.zh: 测试定位，输出为 `data-testid`。

description.en: Focuses the input when it mounts.
description.zh: 挂载时聚焦。

description.en: Called when the input gets the focus.
description.zh: 获得焦点时调用。

description.en: Called when the input loses the focus.
description.zh: 失去焦点时调用。

description.en: Called on key presses in the input.
description.zh: 在输入框中按键时调用。

examples.name: Basic

description.en: Each level opens in its own column; `→` opens the next level and `←` goes back.
description.zh: 每一层在单独的一列中展开；`→` 展开下一层，`←` 返回上一层。

examples.name: Variants

description.en: `showSearch` searches across all levels; `multiple` picks several values.
description.zh: `showSearch` 跨层级搜索；`multiple` 选择多个值。

examples.name: Disabled

summary.en:
Checkbox for multiple choices, or a single yes/no choice such as "Also delete the data". Use `Checkbox.Group`
for a group of options. Settings that take effect immediately use Switch; choices that take effect on submit use
Checkbox.
summary.zh: 复选框：多选或单个开关式的勾选（如「同时删除数据」）。一组选项用 `Checkbox.Group`。立即生效的开关用 Switch；需要提交才生效的勾选用 Checkbox。

usage.en: Boolean form fields, permission checkboxes, bulk selection
usage.zh: 表单中的布尔字段、权限勾选、批量选择

description.en: Checked (controlled).
description.zh: 是否勾选（受控）。

description.en: Initially checked (uncontrolled).
description.zh: 初始是否勾选（非受控）。

description.en:
Partly checked, such as a "select all" box when only some items are selected. Only the appearance changes;
`checked` still decides the value.
description.zh: 部分勾选，如只选中了一部分时的「全选」框。只改变外观，值仍由 `checked` 决定。

description.en: Called with the new checked state.
description.zh: 勾选状态变化时调用，参数是新的勾选状态。

description.en: Label next to the box; clicking it toggles the box.
description.zh: 复选框旁边的文字，点击它也会切换勾选。

description.en: The native `<input type="checkbox">`.
description.zh: 原生的 `<input type="checkbox">`。

examples.name: Basic

description.en: A single checkbox: an option that takes effect when the form is submitted.
description.zh: 单个勾选：需要提交才生效的选项。

examples.name: Group

description.en: The value of `Checkbox.Group` is an array of the checked options.
description.zh: `Checkbox.Group` 的值为选中项的数组。

examples.name: States

summary.en:
ColorPicker picks a color in a panel (saturation area, hue and alpha, a text field in HEX, RGB or HSB) and shows
it in a swatch; `presets` offers a set of colors to pick from, and `showText` shows the value next to the
swatch.

**Interaction**: the swatch is a button: `Tab` focuses it and shows the focus ring, and `Enter` / `Space` or a
click open the panel, with focus moving into the panel. `Esc` closes it and focus returns to the swatch.
summary.zh:
颜色选择：在面板中选择颜色（饱和度区域、色相与透明度、HEX / RGB / HSB 文本输入），结果显示在色块中；`presets`
提供一组预设颜色，`showText` 在色块旁显示取值。

**交互**：色块是一个按钮：`Tab` 聚焦并显示焦点环，`Enter` / 空格或点击打开面板，焦点移入面板；`Esc` 关闭，焦点回到色块。

usage.en: Label and tag colors, brand colors in settings, annotation colors
usage.zh: 标签颜色、设置中的品牌色、标注颜色

description.en: Current color as a hex string (controlled), such as `#2d6bf3`, or `#2d6bf380` with transparency.
description.zh: 当前颜色（受控），十六进制字符串，如 `#2d6bf3`；带透明度时如 `#2d6bf380`。

description.en: Initial color (uncontrolled); any CSS color string.
description.zh: 初始颜色（非受控），任意 CSS 颜色字符串。

description.en: Called with the new color as a lowercase hex string (with alpha when it is not opaque).
description.zh: 颜色变化时调用，参数是小写的十六进制字符串（不透明时不带透明度）。

description.en: Groups of preset colors shown below the panel.
description.zh: 面板下方的预设颜色分组。

description.en: Shows the value as text next to the swatch.
description.zh: 在色块旁以文字显示取值。

description.en: Hides the alpha slider: the color is always opaque.
description.zh: 隐藏透明度滑块：颜色总是不透明。

description.en: Disables the picker.
description.zh: 禁用。

description.en: Size of the swatch.
description.zh: 色块的尺寸。

description.en: The panel is open (controlled).
description.zh: 面板是否打开（受控）。

description.en: Called when the panel opens or closes.
description.zh: 面板打开或关闭时调用。

description.en:
Accessible name of the built-in trigger; the built-in text by default ("Color"). Not used when `children`
provides a custom trigger.
description.zh: 内置触发块的读屏名称，默认为内置文本（「颜色」）。用 `children` 自定义触发元素时不使用。

description.en: Custom trigger instead of the swatch, such as a Button.
description.zh: 自定义的触发元素（代替色块），如 Button。

examples.name: Basic

description.en: Click the swatch, or focus it with `Tab` and press `Enter`; `showText` shows the value next to it.
description.zh: 点击色块，或用 `Tab` 聚焦后按 `Enter`；`showText` 在旁边显示取值。

examples.name: Presets

description.en: `presets` offers a set of colors to pick from; `disabledAlpha` hides the alpha slider.
description.zh: `presets` 提供一组可选的颜色；`disabledAlpha` 隐藏透明度滑条。

examples.name: Disabled

summary.en:
A context menu: wraps any content and opens a menu of actions on right click, `Shift+F10` or the menu key, at
the pointer or next to the focused element. The menu is the Dropdown menu of the library.

**Interaction**: right click opens the menu at the pointer; `Shift+F10` or the menu key opens it below the
focused element. Focus moves into the menu: `↑` / `↓` move between items (skipping disabled items and
dividers), `Enter` runs one and `Esc` closes the menu; after closing, focus returns to the element that was
focused before. Clicking elsewhere closes it and leaves focus on the clicked element. Inside text fields the
browser's own menu (copy, paste) is kept. Shortcut hints are shown with Kbd.
summary.zh:
右键菜单：包住任意内容，右键、`Shift+F10` 或菜单键时在指针处或聚焦元素旁弹出操作菜单。菜单就是组件库的 Dropdown 菜单。

**交互**：右键在指针处打开；`Shift+F10` 或菜单键在聚焦元素下方打开。焦点进入菜单：`↑` / `↓` 在菜单项之间移动（跳过禁用项与分隔线），`Enter` 执行，`Esc` 关闭；关闭后焦点回到打开前的元素。在别处点击时关闭，焦点留在被点击的元素上。在文字输入框中保留浏览器自己的菜单（复制、粘贴）。快捷键提示用 Kbd 显示。

usage.en: Actions on list rows, files, images and messages, in the habits of desktop applications
usage.zh: 列表行、文件、图片、消息上的操作，符合桌面应用习惯

description.en:
Menu items: actions (`key`, `label`, `icon`, `danger`, `disabled`, `shortcut`, `onClick`) and dividers
(`{ type: 'divider' }`). With no items, the browser's own menu is shown.
description.zh: 菜单项：操作（`key`、`label`、`icon`、`danger`、`disabled`、`shortcut`、`onClick`）与分隔线（`{ type: 'divider' }`）。没有菜单项时显示浏览器自己的菜单。

description.en:
The content that has the menu: a list row, a file, an image, a message. For keyboard users, the content (or
an element inside it) must be focusable.
description.zh: 带菜单的内容：列表行、文件、图片、消息。键盘用户要能打开菜单，内容（或其中的元素）必须可以聚焦。

description.en: Called with the key of the chosen item, after its `onClick`.
description.zh: 选择菜单项后调用（在该项的 `onClick` 之后），参数是菜单项的 key。

description.en: Called when the menu opens or closes.
description.zh: 菜单打开或关闭时调用。

description.en: Disables the menu: right click shows the browser's own menu.
description.zh: 禁用：右键时显示浏览器自己的菜单。

examples.name: Basic

description.en:
Right click a row, or focus it and press `Shift+F10` (or the menu key). The rows are focusable, so keyboard
users can open the menu too.
description.zh: 在行上右键，或聚焦后按 `Shift+F10`（或菜单键）。行可以聚焦，键盘用户同样能打开菜单。

examples.name: DisabledItems

description.en:
Disabled items are shown but skipped by `↑` / `↓`; dividers separate groups of actions. Each item can have an
`onClick` of its own.
description.zh: 禁用项照常显示，但 `↑` / `↓` 会跳过它；分隔线把操作分组。每个菜单项可以有自己的 `onClick`。

summary.en:
A button that copies a text to the clipboard. It only writes to the clipboard and never reads from it.

**Interaction**: hover and press add the shared state layer, `Tab` focus shows the focus ring and `Enter` /
`Space` copy. After copying, the icon turns into a check mark for 2 seconds, the tooltip says "Copied" and
screen readers announce "Copied". When copying fails, the icon turns into a warning sign for 4 seconds, the
tooltip and the announcement say "Couldn't copy", and `onError` is called. The width of the button with a
label does not change.
summary.zh:
复制按钮：把一段文字复制到剪贴板。只写入、不读取剪贴板。

**交互**：悬停与按下叠加统一状态层，`Tab` 聚焦显示焦点环，`Enter` / `Space` 复制。复制成功后图标变为勾、持续 2 秒，提示显示「已复制」，读屏播报「已复制」；失败时图标变为警示、持续 4 秒，提示与播报为「复制失败」，并调用 `onError`。带文字的按钮宽度不变。

usage.en: Copying tokens, links, IDs and code examples
usage.zh: 复制令牌、链接、编号与代码示例

description.en: The text to copy.
description.zh: 要复制的文字。

description.en:
Label: the text of the button with `showLabel`, otherwise the tooltip and the accessible name. "Copy" by
default (follows `locale`).
description.zh: 文字说明：`showLabel` 时是按钮文字，否则是提示与读屏名称。默认「复制」（随 `locale`）。

description.en:
Shows the label next to the icon (a Button); by default only the icon is shown (an IconButton with a
tooltip).
description.zh: 在图标旁显示文字（Button 外观）；默认只显示图标（带提示的 IconButton 外观）。

description.en: Size of the icon-only button: `sm` inside code blocks and list items, `md` in toolbars.
description.zh: 只有图标时的尺寸：sm 用于代码块与列表行内，md 用于工具栏。

description.en: Disables the button.
description.zh: 禁用。

description.en: Called after the text has been written to the clipboard.
description.zh: 文字写入剪贴板之后调用。

description.en:
Called when copying fails: the Clipboard API is not available (it requires a secure context, HTTPS or
localhost) or the browser refused to write. The button shows the failed state either way; without `onError`
the error is reported with `reportError`.
description.zh: 复制失败时调用：没有剪贴板接口（需要安全上下文，即 HTTPS 或 localhost）或浏览器拒绝写入。无论是否提供，按钮都会显示失败状态；不提供时错误通过 `reportError` 上报。

examples.name: Basic

description.en: An icon button with a tooltip next to the text it copies. After copying, the icon turns into a check mark.
description.zh: 放在被复制文字旁的图标按钮，带提示。复制后图标变为勾。

examples.name: WithLabel

description.en: `showLabel` shows the label next to the icon, for a copy action that deserves a button of its own.
description.zh: `showLabel` 在图标旁显示文字，用于需要单独一个按钮的复制操作。

examples.name: Failure

description.en:
Copying fails without a secure context (HTTPS) or when the browser refuses; the button shows the failed state
and `onError` receives the error.
description.zh: 没有安全上下文（HTTPS）或浏览器拒绝时复制会失败：按钮显示失败状态，`onError` 收到错误。

summary.en:
A count badge: a pill with tabular numbers. Use the accent color for unread items and to-dos, and the neutral
color for plain counts.
summary.zh: 计数徽标：等宽数字的胶囊。未读、待办用强调色，普通计数用中性色。

usage.en: Unread counts of conversations, to-do counts, team sizes, number of entries in a group
usage.zh: 会话未读数、待办数、团队人数、分组条目数

description.en: The count; nothing is shown when it is 0.
description.zh: 数量；为 0 时不显示。

description.en:
Tone: `accent` for unread items and to-dos that need attention; `neutral` for plain counts (members, child
items).
description.zh: 色调：accent 用于需要处理的未读与待办；neutral 用于普通计数（成员数、子项数）。

description.en: Counts above this value are shown as "max+".
description.zh: 超过该值显示为「上限+」。

examples.name: Basic

description.en: Neutral for plain counts, accent for unread and to-do items; hidden when the count is 0.
description.zh: 普通计数用中性色，未读与待办用强调色；为 0 时不显示。

summary.en:
Date picker: picks a date (with a time when `showTime` is set, or a month with `picker="month"`). Use
`DatePicker.RangePicker` for a date range. Values are ISO strings such as `2026-11-06`, so they can be stored and
sent to a server as they are.
summary.zh: 日期选择：选择日期（`showTime` 时含时间、`picker="month"` 选月份）。日期范围用 `DatePicker.RangePicker`。值是 ISO 字符串，如 `2026-11-06`，可以直接存储、传给服务端。

usage.en: Date filters, due dates, start dates
usage.zh: 筛选日期、到期日、开始日期

description.en: The picked date as an ISO string (controlled); `null` when empty.
description.zh: 选择的日期，ISO 字符串（受控）；为空时是 `null`。

description.en: Initial date (uncontrolled).
description.zh: 初始日期（非受控）。

description.en: Called with the new value as an ISO string; `null` when cleared.
description.zh: 值变化时调用，参数是 ISO 字符串；清除时是 `null`。

description.en: Text shown while there is no value.
description.zh: 没有值时显示的文字。

description.en: What is picked: a `date` (the default), a `month` or a `year`. The value is `2026-11-06`, `2026-11` or `2026`.

Also picks a time; the value becomes an ISO date-time with the local offset, such as
`2026-11-06T14:30:00+08:00`.
description.zh: 同时选择时间；值变为带本地时区偏移的 ISO 日期时间，如 `2026-11-06T14:30:00+08:00`。

description.en: Days that cannot be picked, such as dates in the past. Receives the date as `YYYY-MM-DD`.
description.zh: 不能选择的日期，如过去的日期。参数是 `YYYY-MM-DD` 格式的日期。

description.en:
Display format of the value in the field, such as `YYYY/MM/DD` or `HH:mm` (dayjs tokens). It does not change the
format of the value.
description.zh: 框中显示的格式，如 `YYYY/MM/DD`、`HH:mm`（dayjs 的格式记号）。不改变值的格式。

description.en: Shows a clear button while there is a value.
description.zh: 有值时显示清除按钮。

description.en: Disables the field.
description.zh: 禁用。

description.en: Size: `sm` in table rows and toolbars, `lg` for prominent forms. Without it, the size follows the density.
description.zh: 尺寸：`sm` 用于表格行内与工具栏，`lg` 用于醒目的表单。省略时随密度。

description.en: Appearance: `filled` (neutral background, the default) or `borderless`.
description.zh: 外观：`filled` 填充式（中性底，默认）或 `borderless` 无底色。

description.en: Validation status, usually set by Form.Item.
description.zh: 校验状态，通常由 Form.Item 设置。

description.en: Fills the width of the container.
description.zh: 占满容器的宽度。

description.en: Id of the input element, so that a `<label for>` can point to it (Form.Item sets it).
description.zh: 输入元素的 id，供 `<label for>` 指向（Form.Item 会设置）。

description.en: Accessible name, when there is no visible label.
description.zh: 读屏名称，没有可见的标签时提供。

description.en: Id of the element that labels the input.
description.zh: 作为标签的元素的 id。

description.en: Id of the element that describes the input, such as a hint.
description.zh: 说明这个输入的元素（如提示文字）的 id。

description.en: Test id, output as `data-testid`.
description.zh: 测试定位，输出为 `data-testid`。

description.en: Focuses the input when it mounts.
description.zh: 挂载时聚焦。

description.en: Called when the input gets the focus.
description.zh: 获得焦点时调用。

description.en: Called when the input loses the focus.
description.zh: 失去焦点时调用。

description.en: Called on key presses in the input.
description.zh: 在输入框中按键时调用。

examples.name: Basic

description.en: Pick a date.
description.zh: 选择一个日期。

examples.name: Variants

description.en:
`picker="month"` picks a month, `showTime` includes the time, and `DatePicker.RangePicker` picks a start and an
end date.
description.zh: `picker="month"` 选月份，`showTime` 含时间，`DatePicker.RangePicker` 选择起止日期。

summary.en:
Dropdown menu: a list of actions (`menu.items`) that opens when the trigger is clicked or hovered. The trigger is
usually an IconButton or a Button.

**Interaction**: a menu opened by click (or right click) moves focus into the menu; `↑` / `↓` move between items,
`Enter` runs one and `Esc` closes the menu. After closing, focus returns to the trigger (when the menu is closed
by clicking elsewhere on the page, focus stays on the clicked element). Menus opened on hover do not move focus.
summary.zh:
下拉菜单：点击或悬停触发元素后弹出一组操作（`menu.items`）。触发元素通常是 IconButton 或 Button。

**交互**：点击（或右键）触发的菜单打开后焦点进入菜单，`↑` / `↓` 在菜单项之间移动，`Enter` 执行；
`Esc` 关闭；关闭后焦点回到触发元素（在页面别处点击关闭时，焦点留在被点击的元素上）。悬停触发的菜单不移动焦点。

usage.en: "More" actions in a row, account menus, theme switching, several options for creating something
usage.zh: 行内「更多」操作、账户菜单、主题切换、新建的多个选项

examples.name: Basic

description.en: A "More" menu in a row: the trigger is an IconButton, and a click opens the menu.
description.zh: 行内「更多」操作：触发元素用 IconButton，点击弹出菜单。

summary.en:
Collects, validates and submits data. Fields go in `Form.Item` and `Form.useForm()` returns the form instance. Fields
are validated on blur, and submitting scrolls to and focuses the first invalid field.

**Interaction**: a field is validated on blur and does not interrupt typing; once it has shown an error, it is
validated on every change, so the error disappears as soon as it is corrected; errors appear below the field.
Submitting validates all fields, then scrolls to and focuses the first invalid one. When `validateTrigger` is set
on Form or Form.Item, validation follows it instead.
summary.zh:
表单：收集、校验与提交数据。字段放在 `Form.Item` 中，`Form.useForm()` 取得表单实例。表单在失焦时校验，提交时滚动并聚焦到第一个错误字段。

**交互**：字段在失焦时校验，输入过程中不打断；出过错的字段改为随输入校验，改正后错误立即消失；错误显示在字段下方；提交时校验全部字段，滚动并聚焦到第一个错误字段。在 Form 或 Form.Item 上指定 `validateTrigger` 时按指定的时机校验。

usage.en: Create and edit dialogs, settings pages, sign-in
usage.zh: 新建与编辑弹窗、设置页、登录

description.en: The form instance from `Form.useForm()`, to read and write the form from outside.
description.zh: `Form.useForm()` 返回的表单实例，用于在表单外部读写。

description.en:
Layout of the fields: `vertical` (label above the field, the usual choice), `horizontal` (label on the left)
or `inline` (fields in one row, such as a filter bar).
description.zh: 字段的布局：`vertical` 标签在上（通常用它），`horizontal` 标签在左，`inline` 字段排成一行（如筛选栏）。

description.en: Initial values of the fields.
description.zh: 字段的初始值。

description.en: Called with the values when the form is submitted and every field is valid.
description.zh: 提交且全部字段有效时调用，参数是表单的值。

description.en: Called when the form is submitted but some fields are invalid.
description.zh: 提交但有字段无效时调用。

description.en: Called when the user changes a value, with the changed values and all values.
description.zh: 用户修改值时调用，参数是变化的值与全部的值。

description.en: Disables all fields.
description.zh: 禁用全部字段。

description.en:
Marks required fields: `true` (the default), `false` for no mark, or `optional` to mark the optional fields
instead.
description.zh: 必填标记：`true`（默认）、`false` 不显示，`optional` 改为标记选填的字段。

description.en:
When fields are validated, for example `onChange`. By default a field is validated on blur, and on every change
once it has shown an error.
description.zh: 字段在什么时候校验，如 `onChange`。默认在失焦时校验，出过错之后随输入校验。

description.en: Name of the form; it prefixes the ids of the fields.
description.zh: 表单名，作为字段 id 的前缀。

description.en: Contents of the form: Form.Item fields, the submit button and so on.
description.zh: 表单内容：Form.Item 与提交按钮等。

description.en: The native `<form>` element.
description.zh: 原生的 `<form>` 元素。

examples.name: Basic

description.en:
Put fields in `Form.Item` and declare validation with `rules`; on submit, `onFinish` receives the values of all
fields.
description.zh: 字段放在 Form.Item 中，`rules` 声明校验；提交时 `onFinish` 收到全部字段值。

examples.code:
export function Basic() {
  return (
    <Form layout="vertical" onFinish={() => {}}>
      <Form.Item
        label="Project name"
        name="name"
        rules={[{ required: true, message: 'Enter a name' }]}
      >
        <Input placeholder="For example: Website redesign" />
      </Form.Item>
      <Form.Item label="Visibility" name="visibility" initialValue="team">
        <Select
          options={[
            { value: 'team', label: 'Team only' },
            { value: 'public', label: 'Public' },
          ]}
        />
      </Form.Item>
      <Form.Item label="Notifications" name="notify" valuePropName="checked" initialValue>
        <Switch />
      </Form.Item>
      <Button variant="primary" type="submit">
        Save
      </Button>
    </Form>
  )
}

examples.name: WithInstance

description.en:
`Form.useForm()` returns an instance that validates and submits the form from outside, such as the confirm
button of a dialog.
description.zh: `Form.useForm()` 取得实例，在弹窗的确认按钮等表单外部触发校验与提交。

summary.en:
A heading whose font, weight and letter spacing come from tokens. Use Page for page titles and Section for
group titles; use Heading on its own only in other places.
summary.zh: 标题：标题字体、字重与字距取令牌。页面标题用 Page，分组标题用 Section，其余场景才单独用它。

usage.en: Titles in dialogs, drawers and custom areas
usage.zh: 弹窗、抽屉、自定义区域中的标题

description.en: Heading level: 1 for the page title (usually rendered by Page), 2 for block titles, 3 for subsection titles.
description.zh: 标题级别：1 页面标题（通常由 Page 生成）、2 区块标题、3 小节标题。

description.en: Heading text.
description.zh: 标题文字。

examples.name: Basic

description.en: Use Page for page titles and Section for groups; use Heading directly only in custom areas.
description.zh: 页面标题用 Page，分组用 Section；只有自定义区域才直接用 Heading。

summary.en: A line icon (Lucide), referenced by name, with a consistent stroke width.
summary.zh: 线性图标（Lucide），按名称引用，线宽统一。

usage.en: Icons in buttons, list items, menus and empty states; the `icon` field of menu items uses the same names
usage.zh: 按钮、列表行、菜单、空状态中的图标；菜单配置的 `icon` 字段用同一套名称

description.en: Icon name, see `iconNames` (only registered icons can be used).
description.zh: 图标名称，见 `iconNames`（只能使用登记过的图标）。

description.en: Size in pixels, 16 by default.
description.zh: 像素尺寸，默认 16。

description.en: Stroke width, 1.75 by default (thin but crisp).
description.zh: 线宽，默认 1.75（细而清晰）。

description.en:
Color: `inherit` follows the text color (default); the others are semantic colors. State colors such as hover
and selected are controlled by the surrounding element.
description.zh: 颜色：inherit 跟随文字颜色（默认）；其余为语义色。悬停、选中等状态色由外层元素控制。

description.en: Text label for meaningful icons; omit it for purely decorative icons (hidden from screen readers).
description.zh: 有含义的图标需要文字说明；纯装饰图标省略（对读屏隐藏）。

examples.name: Basic

description.en: Referenced by name; the color follows the text color.
description.zh: 按名称引用；颜色继承文字颜色。

summary.en:
A square icon button with a transparent background, a tooltip and an accessible name.

**Interaction**: hover and press add the shared state layer (press darkens immediately and recovers 120 ms
after release, without scaling); `Tab` focus shows the focus ring, and `Enter` / `Space` trigger the button;
`active` is the pressed state of a toggle button (subtle accent background); when disabled, the opacity is
lowered and there is no state layer, and with `disabledReason` the reason is shown on hover or focus.
summary.zh:
图标按钮：方形、透明底，带提示与读屏名称。

**交互**：悬停与按下叠加统一状态层（按下立即变深，松开 120ms 恢复，不缩放）；`Tab` 聚焦显示焦点环，
`Enter` / `Space` 触发；`active` 为切换按钮的按下态（强调色浅底）；禁用时降低透明度、没有状态层，提供 `disabledReason` 时悬停或聚焦显示原因。

usage.en: Secondary actions in toolbars and list items (refresh, more, download, close); accent style for Send
usage.zh: 工具栏与列表行里的次要操作（刷新、更多、下载、关闭）；强调样式用于发送等主操作

description.en: Icon name.
description.zh: 图标名称。

description.en: Text label, used as the tooltip and the accessible name (required: an icon button must be understandable).
description.zh: 文字说明：作为提示与读屏名称（必填，图标按钮必须可理解）。

description.en:
`accent`: solid accent color (such as Send); `ghost`: transparent background (default); `soft`: neutral
fill.
description.zh: `accent`：强调色实心（如发送）；`ghost`：透明底（默认）；`soft`：中性填充底。

description.en: Size: `sm` inside list items, `md` in toolbars, `lg` for the primary action next to an input (such as Send).
description.zh: 尺寸：sm 用于列表行内，md 用于工具栏，lg 用于输入框旁的主操作（如发送）。

description.en: Whether to show the tooltip on hover; shown by default.
description.zh: 是否显示悬停提示，默认显示。

description.en: Pressed state (for toggle buttons).
description.zh: 按下态（切换按钮）。

description.en:
Disabled reason: while `disabled`, hover or keyboard focus shows "label: reason", such as "You don't have
permission to download". With a reason, the button can still be focused with `Tab` (`aria-disabled`), screen
readers read the reason through `aria-describedby`, and clicks and `Enter` have no effect; the reason is
shown even with `tooltip={false}`.
description.zh: 禁用原因：`disabled` 时悬停或键盘聚焦显示「说明：原因」，如「没有下载权限」。提供后按钮仍可用 Tab 聚焦（`aria-disabled`），读屏通过 `aria-describedby` 读出原因，点击与回车不生效；即使 `tooltip={false}` 也会显示原因。

examples.name: Basic

description.en: `label` is required: it is the tooltip and the accessible name.
description.zh: label 必填：作为悬停提示与读屏名称。

examples.name: Variants

description.en:
`soft` suits places that need a visible boundary; `accent` is for main actions such as sending; `active` is the
pressed state of a toggle button.
description.zh: soft 用于需要边界感的位置；accent 用于发送等主操作；active 表示切换按钮的按下态。

examples.name: DisabledReason

description.en:
When a button is disabled because of permissions or unmet conditions, explain why with `disabledReason`: hover
or keyboard focus shows "label: reason".
description.zh: 因权限或条件不满足而禁用时，用 disabledReason 说明原因：悬停或键盘聚焦时显示「说明：原因」。

summary.en:
Single-line text input. Use `Input.Password` for passwords, `Input.Search` for searching and `Input.TextArea`
for multi-line text. Filled input: neutral background without a border; on focus it shows a thin accent border
and a focus halo.

`Input.Search` shows the search icon at the start of the field and has no attached button: pressing `Enter`
searches, and clearing the field with `allowClear` also calls `onSearch`.
summary.zh:
输入框：单行文本输入。`Input.Password` 输入密码，`Input.Search` 用于搜索，`Input.TextArea` 输入多行文本。填充式外观：中性底、不描边，聚焦时显示强调色细边与光环。

`Input.Search` 的搜索图标在框内前面，没有附着的按钮：按回车搜索，`allowClear` 时清空也会触发 `onSearch`。

usage.en: Form fields, search fields in toolbars, entering a name in a dialog
usage.zh: 表单字段、工具栏中的搜索框、弹窗内的名称输入

description.en: Content before the text, inside the field, such as an icon.
description.zh: 文字前面、框内的内容，如图标。

description.en:
Native input type, such as `email`, `tel` or `url`. The date and time types show the browser's own picker;
prefer DatePicker and TimePicker for a consistent look.
description.zh: 原生输入类型，如 `email`、`tel`、`url`。日期与时间类型显示浏览器自带的选择器；外观要统一时用 DatePicker、TimePicker。

description.en:
Tabular numbers for numeric input such as amounts, quantities and reference numbers: every digit has the same
width, which makes values easy to align and check (same as `<Text numeric>`).
description.zh: 等宽数字：金额、数量、编号等数字输入，数字位宽一致便于对齐与核对（与 `<Text numeric>` 一致）。

description.en: Handle of the field.
description.zh: 输入框的句柄。

description.en: Current text (controlled).
description.zh: 当前文字（受控）。

description.en: Initial text (uncontrolled).
description.zh: 初始文字（非受控）。

description.en: Called on every change of the text, with the native change event (`e.target.value`).
description.zh: 文字每次变化时调用，参数是原生的变更事件（`e.target.value`）。

description.en: Called when `Enter` is pressed.
description.zh: 按下 `Enter` 时调用。

description.en: Size: `sm` in table rows and toolbars, `lg` for prominent forms. Without it, the size follows the density.
description.zh: 尺寸：`sm` 用于表格行内与工具栏，`lg` 用于醒目的表单。省略时随密度。

description.en: Validation status, usually set by Form.Item: `error` or `warning` colors the field.
description.zh: 校验状态，通常由 Form.Item 设置：`error`、`warning` 时输入框显示对应的颜色。

description.en:
Appearance: `filled` (neutral background, the default) or `borderless` (no background, for fields inside
other surfaces such as a command palette).
description.zh: 外观：`filled` 填充式（中性底，默认），`borderless` 无底色（用于命令面板等其他表面内部）。

description.en: Shows a clear button while the field has text.
description.zh: 有文字时显示清除按钮。

description.en: Content after the text, inside the field, such as a unit.
description.zh: 文字后面、框内的内容，如单位。

examples.name: Basic

description.en: Single-line text, password, search and multi-line text.
description.zh: 单行文本、密码、搜索与多行文本。

examples.name: Search

description.en:
The search icon sits at the start inside the box, with no attached button: `Enter` triggers `onSearch`, and with
`allowClear` the clear button triggers it with an empty string as well. While `loading`, the icon becomes a
loading indicator and `Enter` does not trigger it again.
description.zh:
搜索图标在框内前面，没有附着的按钮：按回车触发 `onSearch`，`allowClear` 时点清除按钮也会以空字符串触发；
`loading` 时图标换成加载指示，期间回车不重复触发。

examples.name: Numeric

description.en:
Add `numeric` to inputs for amounts, quantities and IDs: digits have the same width, which makes values easier to
align and check. Pass amounts as strings, never as floating-point numbers.
description.zh: 金额、数量、编号的输入加 `numeric`，数字位宽一致，便于对齐与核对。金额以字符串传递，不用浮点。

examples.name: States

summary.en:
Numeric input with step buttons and tabular numbers. For exact values such as amounts and quantities, add
`decimal`: the value is passed as a decimal string and never goes through floating point.
summary.zh: 数字输入框：带步进按钮，数字使用等宽字形。金额、数量等精确值加 `decimal`：以十进制字符串传递，不经过浮点。

usage.en: Numeric settings such as days, time limits, quantities and sort order

Called with the new value; `null` when the field is emptied.
Called with the new value as a decimal string; `null` when the field is emptied.
description.zh: 值变化时调用；清空时是 `null`。

description.en:
Smallest value.
Smallest value, as a decimal string.

description.en:
Largest value.
Largest value, as a decimal string.

description.en: Shows the step buttons.

description.en: Validation status, usually set by Form.Item.
description.zh: 校验状态，通常由 Form.Item 设置。

description.zh: 数字后面、框内的内容，如单位。

description.zh: 设置数值上下限；数字使用等宽字形。

description.en:
Use `stringMode` for amounts and quantities: the value is passed as a string and never goes through
floating-point numbers.
