examples.name: Basic

description.en:
The same as a pie chart, drawn as a ring. Slices are separated by a 2 px gap and carry no numbers: the legend,
the tooltip and the table do.
description.zh: 与饼图相同，画成圆环。扇区之间有 2px 间隙，扇区上不写数字：由图例、提示与表格提供。

summary.en:
Heatmap: values over two sets of categories (such as weekdays and hours), colored on a sequential scale for
magnitude or a diverging scale around a midpoint. A color scale with the smallest and largest values (and the
midpoint) is always shown under the cells.

**Interaction**: each cell is its own hover target and gets an outline (its color is the value, so it does not
change); the tooltip shows the column, the row and the value. `Tab` focuses the chart (focus ring only for the
keyboard); the four arrow keys move between cells, skipping empty ones, with the same tooltip; `Home` / `End`
jump to the first and last cell of the row and `Esc` hides the tooltip. The table view lists every cell.
summary.zh:
热力图：两组类别（如星期与小时）上的数值，用顺序色阶表示大小，或用发散色阶表示高于、低于中点。格子下方始终显示色标，标出最小值、最大值（与中点）。

**交互**：每个格子是自己的悬停区域，悬停时加一圈描边（颜色就是数值，所以不变）；提示显示列、行与数值。`Tab`
聚焦图表（焦点环只在键盘操作时出现）；四个方向键在格子之间移动（跳过空格子）并显示同样的提示，`Home` / `End`
跳到这一行的第一个与最后一个格子，`Esc` 关闭提示。表格视图列出全部格子。

usage.en: Activity by weekday and hour, change compared with a target by team and month (diverging)
usage.zh: 按星期与小时的活跃度，各团队每月相对目标的变化（发散）

description.en: The columns, left to right.
description.zh: 各列，从左到右。

description.en: The rows, top to bottom.
description.zh: 各行，从上到下。

description.en: The cells; a cell whose `x` or `y` is not a category, or whose value is missing, is not drawn.
description.zh: 各格子；`x`、`y` 不是已有类别或数值缺失的格子不画。

description.en:
`sequential`: one hue from the smallest to the largest value (magnitude); `diverging`: two opposite hues on
both sides of `midpoint`, gray at the midpoint (above or below a baseline).
description.zh: `sequential`：单一色相，从最小值到最大值（大小）；`diverging`：`midpoint` 两侧冷暖相对的两种色相，中点为灰色（高于或低于基线）。

description.en: The value of the neutral middle of a diverging scale; the scale is symmetric around it.
description.zh: 发散色阶中性中点的数值；色阶以它为中心对称。

description.en: How values are written in the color scale, the tooltip and the table.
description.zh: 数值的写法：色标、提示与表格共用。

description.en: Name of the columns: the header of the first column of the table view.
description.zh: 列的名称：表格视图第一列的表头。

description.en: Name of the rows: the header of the second column of the table view.
description.zh: 行的名称：表格视图第二列的表头。

description.en:
Name of the values, in the tooltip and as the header of the value column. "Value" by default in the table
(follows `locale`).
description.zh: 数值的名称，用于提示与表格的数值列表头。表格中默认「数值」（随 `locale`）。

description.en: Title of the chart: what is plotted. It is also the accessible name of the graphic.
description.zh: 图表标题：画的是什么。同时是图形的读屏名称。

description.zh: 标题下的简短说明，如时间范围、单位。

图形的高度（像素），包含坐标轴文字。各种状态占同样的高度。表格视图从这个高度起随行数变高，最多 480px

examples.name: Basic

description.en:
A sequential scale for magnitude: lighter is less, darker is more (in dark mode, brighter is more). The color
scale under the cells gives the smallest and largest values.
description.zh: 顺序色阶表示大小：越浅越小、越深越大（深色模式下越亮越大）。格子下方的色标标出最小值与最大值。

examples.name: Diverging

description.en:
`scale="diverging"` colors values above and below `midpoint` (0 by default) with two opposite hues, and the
midpoint itself in gray.
description.zh: `scale="diverging"` 用冷暖相对的两种色相表示高于、低于 `midpoint`（默认 0）的数值，中点本身为灰色。

summary.en:
Line chart: one or more series over ordered categories, usually time. Use it for trends; for a single series
where the volume matters, AreaChart. The value axis fits the range of the data with rounded ticks, so changes
stay visible; `includeZero` makes it start at 0.

**Interaction**: a vertical crosshair follows the pointer and snaps to the nearest category; the tooltip lists
every visible series at that category, values first. `Tab` focuses the chart (focus ring only for the
keyboard); `←` / `→` move between categories with the same tooltip, `Home` / `End` jump to the first and last,
`Esc` hides the tooltip. Legend items show and hide series without changing colors; the "Chart / Table" switch
shows every value as a table.
summary.zh:
折线图：有序类别（通常是时间）上的一个或多个系列，用于看趋势；单个系列且关心总量时用 AreaChart。数值轴贴合数据的范围（取整的刻度），变化才看得清；`includeZero` 让它从 0 开始。

**交互**：竖向十字线跟随指针并吸附到最近的类别，提示列出该类别上全部显示中的系列（数值在前）。`Tab` 聚焦图表（焦点环只在键盘操作时出现）；`←` / `→` 在类别之间移动并显示同样的提示，`Home` / `End` 跳到首尾，`Esc` 关闭提示。图例项显示、隐藏系列，不改变颜色；「图表 / 表格」切换以表格列出全部数值。

usage.en: Trends over time (revenue per month, active users per day), comparing a few series over the same period
usage.zh: 随时间的趋势（每月收入、每日活跃用户），比较同一时期的几个系列

description.en:
The value axis always includes 0. By default it fits the range of the data with rounded ticks, because a line
shows change; include 0 when the distance from zero matters, for example counts that are small.
description.zh: 数值轴总是包含 0。默认数值轴贴合数据的范围（取整的刻度），因为折线表示的是变化；离 0 的距离有意义时（如数量本身就小）再包含 0。

description.en: The rows: one per category (x), with a field per series.
description.zh: 行数据：每个类别（x）一行，每个系列一个字段。

description.en: Field of the rows that holds the category (a text, a number or a date).
description.zh: 行数据中保存类别的字段（文字、数字或日期）。

description.en:
The series, in legend order. Colors follow the position in this array (or `slot`), so hiding or filtering a
series never changes the color of the others. From the 9th series on, the muted color is used.
description.zh: 各系列，按图例顺序。颜色按在数组中的位置（或 `slot`）分配，隐藏、筛掉某个系列不会让其他系列变色。第 9 个起用弱化色。

description.en: How values are written on the value axis, in the tooltip and in the table.
description.zh: 数值的写法：数值轴、提示与表格共用。

description.en: Writes a category, such as a date; by default `String(value)` (dates as `YYYY-MM-DD`).
description.zh: 类别的写法，如日期；默认 `String(value)`（日期为 `YYYY-MM-DD`）。

description.en:
Name of the categories: the header of the first column of the table view. "Category" by default (follows
`locale`).
description.zh: 类别的名称：表格视图第一列的表头。默认「类别」（随 `locale`）。

description.en: Key of the one series the chart is about: it keeps its color and the others use the muted color.
description.zh: 图表要突出的那个系列的 key：它保持自己的颜色，其余系列用弱化色。

description.en: Title of the chart: what is plotted. It is also the accessible name of the graphic.
description.zh: 图表标题：画的是什么。同时是图形的读屏名称。

description.en: A short description under the title, such as the period or the unit.
description.zh: 标题下的简短说明，如时间范围、单位。

Height of the graphic in pixels, axis labels included. The states take the same height. The table view starts at
this height and grows with its rows up to 480 px (or this height when it is taller); only longer tables scroll.
description.zh:
图形的高度（像素），包含坐标轴文字。各种状态占同样的高度。表格视图从这个高度起随行数变高，最多 480px
（本高度更大时以本高度为准），更长的表格才在卡片内滚动。

graphic stays at reduced opacity until the new data arrives.
description.zh: 加载中：没有数据时显示延迟出现的加载指示；已有数据时保留上一次的图形并降低不透明度，直到新数据到来。

description.zh: 错误：`true` 显示默认的错误状态；传入内容时作为错误状态的说明。

description.zh: 出错后重试；提供后错误状态中显示「重试」按钮。

description.en: Text of the empty state when there is no data, "No data" by default (follows `locale`).
description.zh: 没有数据时空状态的文字，默认「暂无数据」（随 `locale`）。

description.en: Actions in the top-right corner, before the view switch (for example a menu or a time range).
description.zh: 右上角的操作，在视图切换之前（如菜单、时间范围）。

description.zh: 不带卡片（没有底色、阴影与内边距），用于放在面板、对话框、抽屉中的图表。

examples.name: Basic

description.en:
One series: the title says what is plotted, so there is no legend. Hover or focus the chart and use `←` / `→`
to read the values; the "Chart / Table" switch lists them all.
description.zh: 一个系列：标题说明画的是什么，不显示图例。悬停或聚焦图表后用 `←` / `→` 读数；「图表 / 表格」切换列出全部数值。

examples.name: Series

description.en:
From two series on, the legend appears; click an item to hide or show its series. Colors follow the position
in `series`, so the other series keep their colors.
description.zh: 两个及以上系列时显示图例；点击图例项隐藏或显示该系列。颜色按 `series` 中的位置分配，其他系列不会变色。

examples.name: Emphasis

description.en: When the chart is about one series, `emphasis` keeps its color and mutes the others.
description.zh: 图表只关心其中一个系列时，用 `emphasis` 保留它的颜色，其余系列用弱化色。

examples.name: States

description.en:
The first load shows a delayed loading indicator at the height of the chart; reloading keeps the previous
lines at reduced opacity. Without rows the empty state is shown, and `error` with `onRetry` shows the error
state with "Retry".
description.zh: 首次加载显示延迟出现的加载指示，高度与图表相同；重新加载时保留上一次的折线并降低不透明度。没有数据时显示空状态；`error` 加 `onRetry` 显示带「重试」的错误状态。

summary.en:
Pie chart: one whole split into a few parts (at most 6 by default; the rest is folded into "Other"). Read at a
glance only: to compare close values use a BarChart, and for part-to-whole prefer SegmentedBar.

**Interaction**: each slice is its own hover target and lifts slightly; the tooltip shows its value and share.
`Tab` focuses the chart (focus ring only for the keyboard); `←` / `→` move between slices with the same
tooltip, `Home` / `End` jump to the first and last, `Esc` hides the tooltip. Legend items hide and show slices
(the shares are recomputed) without changing colors; the table view lists every item, folded ones included.
summary.zh:
饼图：一个整体分成少数几部分（默认最多 6 个，其余合并为「其他」），只用于一眼看出大致比例：比较相近的数值用柱状图，部分占整体首选 SegmentedBar。

**交互**：每个扇区是自己的悬停区域，悬停时稍微提亮，提示显示数值与占比。`Tab` 聚焦图表（焦点环只在键盘操作时出现）；`←` / `→` 在扇区之间移动并显示同样的提示，`Home` / `End` 跳到首尾，`Esc` 关闭提示。图例项隐藏、显示扇区（占比随之重算），不改变颜色；表格视图列出全部项，包括合并进「其他」的。

usage.en: A rough split of one whole into a few parts (storage by file type, traffic by source)
usage.zh: 一个整体粗略分成几部分（按文件类型的存储、按来源的流量）

description.en:
The items. Colors follow the position in this array (or `slot`), so hiding or folding items never changes
the color of the others.
description.zh: 各项。颜色按在数组中的位置（或 `slot`）分配，隐藏、合并某些项不会让其他项变色。

description.en:
Most slices drawn: beyond it, the largest `maxSlices - 1` items are kept and the rest are folded into
"Other" (muted color). The table view still lists every item. At most 8.
description.zh: 最多画几个扇区：超过时保留最大的 `maxSlices - 1` 项，其余合并为「其他」（弱化色）。表格视图仍列出全部项。最多 8。

description.en: How values are written in the tooltip and the table.
description.zh: 数值的写法：提示与表格共用。

description.en: Header of the name column of the table view, "Category" by default (follows `locale`).
description.zh: 表格视图名称列的表头，默认「类别」（随 `locale`）。

description.en: Header of the value column of the table view, "Value" by default (follows `locale`).
description.zh: 表格视图数值列的表头，默认「数值」（随 `locale`）。

description.zh: 图表标题：画的是什么。同时是图形的读屏名称。

examples.name: Basic

description.en:
A rough split of one whole into a few parts. Hover or focus a slice to read its value and share; the table view
lists every item. To compare close values, use a BarChart instead.
description.zh: 一个整体粗略分成几部分。悬停或聚焦扇区读出数值与占比；表格视图列出全部项。要比较相近的数值，改用柱状图。

examples.name: Folding

description.en:
Beyond `maxSlices` (6 by default), the largest items are kept and the rest become one muted "Other" slice. The
table view still lists all eight sources.
description.zh: 超过 `maxSlices`（默认 6）时保留最大的几项，其余合并为一个弱化色的「其他」扇区。表格视图仍列出全部八个来源。

summary.en:
Scatter chart: the relation between two values, one point per item. Points are 8 px dots with a 2 px ring in
the surface color, so overlapping points stay readable.

**Interaction**: the pointer does not have to land on a dot: the nearest point within 16 px shows its tooltip
and lifts. `Tab` focuses the chart (focus ring only for the keyboard); `←` / `→` move between points in order of
their horizontal value with the same tooltip, `Home` / `End` jump to the first and last, `Esc` hides the
tooltip. Legend items show and hide series without changing colors; the table view lists every point.
summary.zh:
散点图：两个数值之间的关系，每个对象一个点。点是 8px 的实心圆，带 2px 表面色外圈，重叠时仍能分清。

**交互**：指针不必正好落在点上：16px 以内最近的点显示提示并提亮。`Tab` 聚焦图表（焦点环只在键盘操作时出现）；
`←` / `→` 按横轴数值的顺序在点之间移动并显示同样的提示，`Home` / `End` 跳到首尾，`Esc` 关闭提示。图例项显示、隐藏系列，不改变颜色；表格视图列出全部点。

usage.en: Correlation between two measures (price and sales, size and duration), spotting outliers
usage.zh: 两个指标的相关性（价格与销量、大小与耗时），发现离群值

description.en:
The series and their points. Use at most 3 series: in a scatter chart any two points can be neighbors, and
only the first 3 chart colors are told apart in every pair.
description.zh: 各系列及其点。最多用 3 个系列：散点图中任意两点都可能相邻，只有前 3 个图表颜色两两都能分清。

description.en: How horizontal values are written on the axis, in the tooltip and in the table.
description.zh: 横轴数值的写法：坐标轴、提示与表格共用。

description.en: How vertical values are written on the axis, in the tooltip and in the table.
description.zh: 纵轴数值的写法：坐标轴、提示与表格共用。

description.en: Name of the horizontal axis: shown under the axis, in the tooltip and as a table header.
description.zh: 横轴名称：显示在横轴下方，也用于提示与表头。

description.en: Name of the vertical axis: shown along the axis, in the tooltip and as a table header.
description.zh: 纵轴名称：沿纵轴显示，也用于提示与表头。

description.en: Key of the one series the chart is about: it keeps its color and the others use the muted color.
description.zh: 图表要突出的那个系列的 key：它保持自己的颜色，其余系列用弱化色。

description.en: Title of the chart: what is plotted. It is also the accessible name of the graphic.
description.zh: 图表标题：画的是什么。同时是图形的读屏名称。

description.zh: 标题下的简短说明，如时间范围、单位。

（本高度更大时以本高度为准），更长的表格才在卡片内滚动。

Loading: without data, a delayed loading indicator takes the place of the graphic; with data, the previous
graphic stays at reduced opacity until the new data arrives.
description.zh: 加载中：没有数据时显示延迟出现的加载指示；已有数据时保留上一次的图形并降低不透明度，直到新数据到来。

description.en: Error: `true` shows the default error state; a node is shown as the message of the error state.
description.zh: 错误：`true` 显示默认的错误状态；传入内容时作为错误状态的说明。

description.en: Retry after an error; shows a "Retry" button in the error state.
description.zh: 出错后重试；提供后错误状态中显示「重试」按钮。

description.zh: 没有数据时空状态的文字，默认「暂无数据」（随 `locale`）。

description.en: Actions in the top-right corner, before the view switch (for example a menu or a time range).
description.zh: 右上角的操作，在视图切换之前（如菜单、时间范围）。

description.zh: 不带卡片（没有底色、阴影与内边距），用于放在面板、对话框、抽屉中的图表。

examples.name: Basic

description.en:
One point per item; `xLabel` and `yLabel` name the axes. The pointer only has to be near a dot: the nearest
point within 16 px shows its tooltip.
description.zh: 每个对象一个点；`xLabel`、`yLabel` 给出两条轴的名称。指针只需靠近点：16px 以内最近的点显示提示。

examples.name: Series

description.en:
Up to 3 series: in a scatter chart any two points can be neighbors, and only the first 3 chart colors are told
apart in every pair. For more groups, fold them into "Other" or use small multiples.
description.zh: 最多 3 个系列：散点图中任意两点都可能相邻，只有前 3 个图表颜色两两都能分清。分组更多时合并为「其他」或拆成多个小图。

summary.en:
A segmented bar shows how one whole splits into a few parts (up to 6 by default), as blocks whose widths are
proportional to the amounts. Use it instead of a pie or a donut. To compare the parts with each other or to
show more of them, use a bar chart; for a single ratio against a limit, use Progress.

**Interaction**: hovering a block shows a tooltip with its amount, share and name; the blocks are one `Tab`
stop, and `←` / `→` (`Home` / `End`) move between them, showing the same tooltip. Screen readers read the
label of the bar and then each part as "Name: amount (share)", without hovering. A label that does not fit
in its block is not printed; the value stays in the tooltip and the accessible name.
summary.zh:
分段条：一个整体分成几个部分（默认最多 6 个），块的宽度与数量成比例。代替饼图与环图。需要比较各部分大小或部分更多时用柱状图；单个比例相对上限时用 Progress。

**交互**：悬停在块上显示提示：数量、占比与名称；所有块只占一个 `Tab` 位置，`←` / `→`（`Home` / `End`）在块之间移动，同样显示提示。读屏先读条的名称，再逐个读出「名称：数量（占比）」，不需要悬停。块里放不下的文字不写；数值仍在提示与读屏名称中。

usage.en: Storage by file type, time spent per phase, budget split, the split of a figure in a table row
usage.zh: 按文件类型的存储占用、各阶段用时、预算拆分、表格行中某个数字的构成

description.en:
The parts, in the order of the blocks. Each keeps the color of its position (or its `slot`) even when
another part is 0 and not drawn. Negative or non-finite values cannot be part of a whole: the bar is then
shown empty (with a warning in development). When every value is 0 the bar is empty too.
description.zh: 各个部分，按色块的顺序。每个部分保持其位置（或 `slot`）对应的颜色，其他部分为 0 不绘制时也不变色。负数与非有限数不能构成整体的一部分：此时整条显示为空（开发模式下给出警告）。全部为 0 时同样为空。

description.en: What the whole is, such as "Storage by file type". Screen readers read it before the parts.
description.zh: 整体是什么，如「按文件类型的存储占用」。读屏先读它，再读各个部分。

description.en:
`tall` (28 px): a bar standing alone, with the share or amount printed in each block that has room for it
and a legend. `thin` (8 px): a bar next to the figures it splits (in a table row or above a list), without
text or legend.
description.zh:
`tall`（28px）：单独出现的条，放得下的块里写着占比或数量，并有图例。
`thin`（8px）：放在它所拆分的数字旁边（表格行中、列表上方），不写文字、默认没有图例。

description.en: Makes the thin bar 4 px high, for dense table rows.
description.zh: 细条的高度改为 4px，用于紧凑的表格行。

description.en: What the tall blocks print: the `share` of the whole (46%) or the `value` (413M, written with `format`).
description.zh: 高条的块里写什么：占整体的比例 `share`（46%），或数量 `value`（413M，按 `format` 写）。

description.en: How amounts are written, in the blocks (with `show="value"`), the tooltip and the accessible names.
description.zh: 数量的写法：用于块内（`show="value"` 时）、提示与读屏名称。

description.en:
The most parts shown, "Other" included (2–8). Past it, the parts after the first `maxItems - 1` are folded
into "Other" in the de-emphasis color, so order the items with the ones to keep first.
description.zh: 最多显示的部分数，含「其他」（2–8）。超过时，前 `maxItems - 1` 个之后的部分合并为「其他」（弱化色），所以把要保留的部分排在前面。

description.en:
Shows a legend under the bar: the names in block order, without numbers. On by default for `tall`, off for
`thin` (in a table, use one legend for the whole table).
description.zh:
在条下方显示图例：按色块顺序列出名称，不重复数字。
`tall` 默认显示，`thin` 默认不显示（表格中整张表共用一个图例）。

examples.name: Basic

description.en:
A tall bar standing alone: each block prints its share where it fits, and the legend lists the names in block
order. Hover a block, or press `Tab` and then `←` / `→`, to see its amount, share and name.
description.zh: 单独出现的高条：放得下的块里写着占比，图例按色块顺序列出名称。悬停在块上，或按 `Tab` 后用 `←` / `→`，查看数量、占比与名称。

examples.name: Variants

description.en:
`show="value"` prints the amount instead of the share. Past `maxItems` parts (6 by default), the tail is folded
into "Other", in the de-emphasis color.
description.zh: `show="value"` 在块里写数量而不是占比。超过 `maxItems` 个部分（默认 6 个）时，尾部合并为「其他」，用弱化色。

examples.code:
export function Variants() {
  return (
    <Panel>
      <Stack gap={5}>
        <SegmentedBar
          variant="tall"
          label="Budget by team"
          show="value"
          format="compact"
          items={[
            { key: 'engineering', name: 'Engineering', value: 413_000_000 },
            { key: 'design', name: 'Design', value: 182_000_000 },
            { key: 'marketing', name: 'Marketing', value: 96_000_000 },
            { key: 'support', name: 'Support', value: 54_000_000 },
          ]}
        />
        <SegmentedBar
          variant="tall"
          label="Visits by country"
          maxItems={4}
          items={[
            { key: 'us', name: 'United States', value: 4_210 },
            { key: 'de', name: 'Germany', value: 1_830 },
            { key: 'jp', name: 'Japan', value: 1_240 },
            { key: 'br', name: 'Brazil', value: 610 },
            { key: 'in', name: 'India', value: 540 },
            { key: 'fr', name: 'France', value: 320 },
          ]}
        />
      </Stack>
    </Panel>
  )
}

examples.name: Thin

description.en:
The thin bar has no text: the figures are beside it. In table rows, use `dense` (4 px) and give the whole table
one legend, here on the bar of the total.
description.zh: 细条不写文字：数字就在旁边。表格行中用 `dense`（4px），整张表共用一个图例，这里放在合计的那条上。

examples.name: Empty

description.en:
Without parts, or when every part is 0, the bar is an empty track of the same height. Negative or non-finite
values are treated the same way, with a warning in development.
description.zh: 没有部分或全部为 0 时，显示同样高度的空轨道。负数与非有限数也这样处理，并在开发模式下给出警告。

summary.en:
A sparkline: a small trend line without axes, for stat tiles and table cells. It is purely graphic: there is
no hover, and the exact values belong next to it or in a table.

**Interaction**: not interactive. The line is 2 px with round joins; by default the history is in the
de-emphasis color and the last value is an accent dot. A gap in the data breaks the line; a lone value is drawn
as a dot. Screen readers read the label and a summary: first and last value, low and high.
summary.zh:
迷你图：没有坐标轴的小趋势线，用于指标卡与表格单元格。纯图形：没有悬停，精确数值放在旁边或表格中。

**交互**：不可交互。线宽 2px、圆角连接；默认历史部分用弱化色，最后一个值是强调色圆点。数据缺失处断开；孤立的一个值画成圆点。读屏读出名称与摘要：起止值、最低、最高。

usage.en: Trends in stat tiles, a trend column in tables, activity over the last weeks in list items
usage.zh: 指标卡中的趋势、表格中的趋势列、列表行中最近几周的活跃度

description.en:
The values, oldest first. `null` (and `NaN`) leaves a gap: the line breaks there. An empty list, or a list
of `null` only, draws nothing.
description.zh: 数值，从早到晚。`null`（以及 `NaN`）留空，线在那里断开。空数组或全是 `null` 时不画线。

description.en:
What the line shows, such as "Visits in the last 12 weeks". Required: screen readers read it followed by a
summary (first and last value, low and high).
description.zh: 这条线表示什么，如「最近 12 周访问量」。必填：读屏先读它，再读自动生成的摘要（起止值、最低、最高）。

description.en: Fills the area under the line with a wash of the line color (about 10% opacity).
description.zh: 在线下方填充线的颜色（约 10% 不透明度）。

description.en: Height: `sm` (20 px) in table cells, `md` (32 px) in stat tiles. The width always fills the container.
description.zh: 高度：`sm`（20px）用于表格单元格，`md`（32px）用于指标卡。宽度总是撑满容器。

description.en:
`last`: the history is drawn in the de-emphasis color and the last value is a dot in the accent color, so
the current value stands out (the rule for stat tile trends). `none`: one plain line in the first chart
color, without a dot.
description.zh:
`last`：历史部分用弱化色，最后一个值是强调色圆点，突出当前值（指标卡趋势的规定）。
`none`：整条线用第一个图表颜色，没有圆点。

description.en:
Draws the whole line in this chart color (1–8), for a sparkline that stands for a series shown elsewhere in
the same color. History and current value are then not told apart by color; with `highlight="last"` the
last value still gets a dot of the same color.
description.zh:
整条线用这个图表颜色（1–8），用于代表别处同色系列的迷你图。此时历史与当前不再用颜色区分；
`highlight="last"` 时最后一个值仍有同色圆点。

description.en: How the values are written in the summary read by screen readers.
description.zh: 读屏摘要中数值的写法。

examples.name: Basic

description.en:
By default the history is in the de-emphasis color and the latest value is an accent dot. The width fills the
container; `label` is what screen readers read, followed by a summary of the values. The dot has a ring in the
surface color, so place sparklines on a surface such as a Panel.
description.zh: 默认历史部分用弱化色，最新的值是强调色圆点。宽度撑满容器；`label` 是读屏读出的名称，后面跟着数值摘要。圆点外有一圈面板表面色，所以迷你图放在 Panel 等面板表面上。

examples.name: Variants

description.en:
`highlight="none"` draws one plain line in the first chart color; `slot` draws the whole line in another chart
color, for a sparkline that stands for a series shown elsewhere in that color.
description.zh: `highlight="none"` 用第一个图表颜色画一条普通的线；`slot` 让整条线用另一个图表颜色，用于代表别处同色系列的迷你图。

examples.name: InTable

description.en: `size="sm"` (20 px high) fits a table cell or a list item; give the column a width.
description.zh: `size="sm"`（20px 高）放进表格单元格或列表行；给这一列设置宽度。

examples.name: Gaps

description.en:
A `null` breaks the line, and a lone value between gaps is drawn as a small dot. A single value is a dot at
the end; no values draw nothing.
description.zh: `null` 让线断开，两个缺口之间孤立的值画成小圆点。只有一个值时在末端画一个圆点；没有值时什么也不画。

summary.en:
A stat tile: a label, a value, its change compared with an earlier period, and an optional trend line. It has
no background or padding of its own: place it in a Panel, and put several of them in a Grid to form a KPI row.

**Interaction**: not interactive. The value is semibold with proportional figures. The change always has an
arrow and a sign, and screen readers read it as a sentence, such as "Up 12.5%, vs last month". While loading,
a skeleton takes the place of the value and appears after 200 ms, so fast loads do not flash; the size does
not change when the data arrives.
summary.zh:
指标卡：标签、数值、与之前某个时期相比的增减，以及可选的趋势线。本身没有底色与内边距：单独使用时放进 Panel，多个指标放进 Grid 组成指标行。

**交互**：不可交互。数值为半粗、比例数字。增减总是同时有箭头与正负号，读屏读成一句话，如「上升 12.5%，与上月相比」。加载时数值位置显示骨架，200ms 后才出现，很快完成的加载不会闪；数据到来时尺寸不变。

usage.en: KPI rows at the top of dashboards, key numbers of a project or a period, figures next to a chart
usage.zh: 仪表盘顶部的指标行、项目或某个时期的关键数字、图表旁的数字

description.en: What the number is, in sentence case and without a trailing colon, such as "Monthly revenue".
description.zh: 数值是什么，句首大写、不带冒号，如「月收入」。

description.en: The value. `null` shows a dash (no data).
description.zh: 数值。`null` 显示为短横线（没有数据）。

description.en: How the value is written; `auto` is in full below 10,000 and compact from there on (1,284 · 12.9K).
description.zh: 数值的写法；`auto` 小于 10,000 时写全，从 10,000 起用紧凑写法（1,284 · 1.3万）。

description.en: Text before the value, in the same style, such as a currency symbol.
description.zh: 数值前的文字，与数值同样的样式，如货币符号。

description.en: A unit after the value, smaller and in the secondary text color, such as "items" or "ms".
description.zh: 数值后的单位，字号较小、次要文字色，如「件」「ms」。

description.en:
The change compared with an earlier period: `{ value, period, format?, goodWhen? }`. It is shown with an
arrow and a sign (+12.5%), never by color alone; its color is the success color when the change is good,
the danger color when it is bad, and the secondary text color with `goodWhen: 'none'` or no change.
description.zh: 与之前某个时期相比的增减：`{ value, period, format?, goodWhen? }`。总是同时显示箭头与正负号（+12.5%），不只靠颜色；向好时为成功色，变差时为危险色，`goodWhen: 'none'` 或没有变化时为次要文字色。

description.en:
Recent values, oldest first, drawn as a Sparkline under the value (about 12 points): the history in the
de-emphasis color, the current value as an accent dot.
description.zh: 最近的数值，从早到晚，在数值下方画成迷你图（约 12 个点）：历史为弱化色，当前值为强调色圆点。

description.en:
Shows a skeleton in place of the value (and of the change and trend, when given) while the data loads; the
size does not change when the data arrives.
description.zh: 数据加载时，数值（以及传入的增减与趋势）的位置显示骨架；数据到来时尺寸不变。

description.en: Size of the value: `md` (24 px) for KPI rows, `lg` (32 px) for the main figure of an area.
description.zh: 数值的尺寸：`md`（24px）用于指标行，`lg`（32px）用于区域内的主要数字。

examples.name: Basic

description.en:
A label, a value, its change compared with an earlier period and a trend of the last 12 periods. The tile has
no background of its own: place it in a Panel.
description.zh: 标签、数值、与之前某个时期相比的增减，以及最近 12 期的趋势。指标卡本身没有底色：放进 Panel。

examples.name: KpiRow

description.en:
Put several tiles in a Grid. Large values are compact (12.9K); `prefix` and `suffix` add a currency or a unit.
When a lower value is better, set `goodWhen: 'down'`: a decrease is then shown in the success color.
description.zh: 多个指标卡放进 Grid。较大的数值用紧凑写法（1.3万）；`prefix`、`suffix` 加上货币或单位。数值越小越好时设置 `goodWhen: 'down'`：下降显示为成功色。

examples.name: Variants

description.en:
`goodWhen: 'none'` keeps the change in the secondary text color when neither direction is better; no change
shows a flat arrow. An absolute change uses its own `format`. `size="lg"` is for the main figure of an area.
description.zh: 两个方向没有好坏之分时用 `goodWhen: 'none'`，增减显示为次要文字色；没有变化时显示水平箭头。绝对数量的增减用它自己的 `format`。`size="lg"` 用于区域内的主要数字。

examples.name: States

description.en:
While `loading`, skeletons take the place of the value, the change and the trend, and appear after 200 ms; the
tile keeps its size when the data arrives. A `null` value shows a dash.
description.zh: `loading` 时数值、增减与趋势的位置显示骨架，200ms 后才出现；数据到来时指标卡尺寸不变。`null` 显示为短横线。

summary.en:
An inline citation marker, such as a superscript 1 after a sentence, that shows its source on hover or focus.
Markdown renders `[1]` as a Citation when it is given `sources`.

**Interaction**: hovering or focusing it with `Tab` shows a popover with the title, the site and the description
of the source, and leaving or `Esc` hides it; it does not move focus. With a safe address the marker is a link
to the source (other sites open in a new tab with `rel="noopener noreferrer"`); otherwise it is a button that
only shows the popover. Screen readers read "Source 1: title".
summary.zh:
行内引用标记，如句末的上标 1，悬停或聚焦时显示它的来源。Markdown 设置了 `sources` 时把 `[1]` 渲染为 Citation。

**交互**：悬停或用 `Tab` 聚焦时弹出卡片，显示来源的标题、站点与说明，离开或按 `Esc` 隐藏；不移动焦点。地址安全时编号本身是指向来源的链接（其他网站在新标签页打开，带 `rel="noopener noreferrer"`），否则是只显示卡片的按钮。读屏读出「来源 1：标题」。

usage.en: Numbered citations in AI answers, footnote-style references in generated text
usage.zh: AI 回答中的编号引用、生成文字中脚注式的引用

description.en: The number shown, usually the position of the source in Sources (starting at 1).
description.zh: 显示的编号，通常是来源在 Sources 中的位置（从 1 开始）。

description.en: The source it refers to.
description.zh: 引用的来源。

examples.name: Basic

description.en:
Place a Citation after the sentence it supports. Hover it or focus it with `Tab` to see the source; the number
links to it.
description.zh: 把 Citation 放在它所支撑的句子后面。悬停或用 `Tab` 聚焦即可看到来源；编号本身链接到来源。

examples.name: InMarkdown

description.en:
Give Markdown the `sources` and it renders `[1]`, `[2]` in the reply as citations; put the list under the reply
with Sources.
description.zh: 给 Markdown 传入 `sources`，回复中的 `[1]`、`[2]` 就显示为引用；回复下方用 Sources 放来源列表。

summary.en:
Renders Markdown written by an AI, also while it streams in. Headings, lists, quotes, tables, inline code and
code blocks follow the theme; code blocks are CodeBlocks with the language and a copy button.

**Security**: raw HTML in the text is always shown as text, never rendered. Links only work for http, https,
mailto and relative addresses (other protocols such as `javascript:` are shown as plain text), and links to
other sites open in a new tab with `rel="noopener noreferrer"`. Images are not loaded unless `allowImage`
allows their address.

**Interaction**: links have the focus ring; a wide table scrolls horizontally inside its frame and can then be
focused with `Tab` and scrolled with the arrow keys. While `streaming`, a static cursor marks the end and the
element is `aria-busy`. Rendered on the server, it outputs the text as plain text and switches to Markdown after
hydration.
summary.zh:
渲染 AI 写出的 Markdown，也可以边接收边渲染。标题、列表、引用、表格、行内代码、代码块都跟随主题；代码块是带语言与复制按钮的 CodeBlock。

**安全**：文本中的原始 HTML 一律显示为文字，不会被渲染。链接只对 http、https、mailto 与相对地址有效（`javascript:`
等其他协议显示为纯文字），指向其他网站的链接在新标签页打开并带 `rel="noopener noreferrer"`。图片只有 `allowImage`
允许的地址才加载。

**交互**：链接有焦点环；宽表格在外框内横向滚动，这时可以用 `Tab` 聚焦并用方向键滚动。`streaming` 时结尾有静止的光标，元素带 `aria-busy`。服务端渲染时输出纯文本，注水后换成 Markdown。

usage.en: AI replies, streamed answers, generated summaries and documentation
usage.zh: AI 回复、流式的回答、生成的摘要与说明文档

description.en:
The Markdown text (CommonMark and GitHub Flavored Markdown: tables, task lists, strikethrough, autolinks).
It can grow while the reply streams in.
description.zh: Markdown 文本（CommonMark 与 GitHub 风格的 Markdown：表格、任务列表、删除线、自动链接）。回复流式到达时可以不断变长。

description.en:
More content is coming: half-written syntax is shown as if finished (`**bold` is already bold, the text of a
link appears before its address), only the part that is still growing is parsed again, and a cursor marks the
end. When it becomes `false`, everything is rendered as final.
description.zh: 还有后续内容：写到一半的语法按写完显示（`**加粗` 已经是粗体，链接的文字先于地址出现），只重新解析还在增长的部分，结尾显示光标。变为 `false` 时按最终内容渲染。

description.en:
Types new content out at a steady pace while `streaming`, instead of showing each chunk as it arrives. Off
with "reduce motion".
description.zh: `streaming` 时把新内容按匀速逐字放出，而不是每个片段到达时整块出现。打开「减少动态效果」时不生效。

description.en:
Decides whether an image is loaded, by its address (only http, https and relative addresses are passed in).
By default no image is loaded: an address written by an AI can send data from the conversation to another
site. Images that are not loaded are shown as their alternative text, linked to the address.
description.zh: 按地址决定是否加载图片（只会传入 http、https 与相对地址）。默认不加载任何图片：AI 写出的图片地址可以把对话中的数据带到别的网站。不加载的图片显示为替代文字，并链接到图片地址。

description.en:
The sources the reply cites. With them, `[1]` (or `[^1]`) in the text is shown as a Citation of the first
source, with a popover on hover and focus; numbers without a source stay as text. Show the list itself with
Sources.
description.zh: 回复引用的来源。设置后，文本中的 `[1]`（或 `[^1]`）显示为第一个来源的 Citation，悬停与聚焦时弹出卡片；没有对应来源的编号保持为文字。来源列表本身用 Sources 显示。

examples.name: Basic

description.en:
Pass the Markdown text. Headings, lists, task lists, tables, quotes, inline code and code blocks follow the theme;
code blocks show their language and a copy button.
description.zh: 传入 Markdown 文本。标题、列表、任务列表、表格、引用、行内代码、代码块都跟随主题；代码块显示语言与复制按钮。

examples.name: Streaming

description.en:
While the reply streams in, set `streaming`: half-written syntax is shown as if finished, and a cursor marks the
end. `typewriter` smooths out chunks that arrive in bursts.
description.zh: 回复流式到达时设置 `streaming`：写到一半的语法按写完显示，结尾有光标。`typewriter` 让成块到达的内容匀速放出。

examples.name: Untrusted

description.en:
Raw HTML is always shown as text, and links with other protocols such as `javascript:` are plain text. Images are
not loaded by default; `allowImage` decides by address (here only the `assets.example.com` host).
description.zh: 原始 HTML 一律显示为文字，`javascript:` 等其他协议的链接是纯文字。图片默认不加载；`allowImage` 按地址决定（这里只允许 `assets.example.com`）。

summary.en:
One message of a conversation. User messages are right-aligned in a bubble with a neutral fill; assistant
messages are left-aligned without a bubble and use the full width, optionally with an avatar and a name. Place
it in MessageList.

**Interaction**: while a reply is generated and still empty, "Generating" appears after 200 ms (no flash for
fast replies; the indicator is static when motion is reduced). A failed reply keeps the text received so far and
adds a note with "Retry"; a stopped reply adds "Stopped". The actions appear on hover or when keyboard focus
enters the message, without changing the height of the message (their place is kept); on touch screens and with
`showActions="always"` they are always visible.
summary.zh:
对话中的一条消息。用户消息靠右，在中性填充的气泡中；助手消息靠左、不加气泡、占满宽度，可以有头像与名字。放在
MessageList 中使用。

**交互**：回复生成中且还没有内容时，200ms 后出现「正在生成」（很快的回复不会闪出；减少动态效果时指示静止）。失败的回复保留已经收到的文字，并追加带「重试」的说明；被停止的回复追加「已停止」。操作在悬停或键盘焦点进入消息时出现，消息的高度不变（位置预先留好）；触屏上以及 `showActions="always"` 时始终可见。

usage.en: Messages of an AI chat, replies with copy and retry, failed or stopped generations
usage.zh: AI 对话中的消息、带复制与重试的回复、失败或被停止的生成

description.en:
Who wrote the message: `user` messages are right-aligned in a bubble, `assistant` messages are left-aligned
without a bubble and use the full width.
description.zh: 作者：`user` 的消息靠右、在气泡中；`assistant` 的消息靠左、不加气泡、占满宽度。

description.en:
The content: plain text (line breaks are kept) or rendered content such as Markdown. While `status` is
`streaming` and there is no content yet, a loading indicator is shown instead.
description.zh: 内容：纯文本（保留换行）或渲染好的内容（如 Markdown）。`status` 为 `streaming` 且还没有内容时，改为显示加载指示。

description.en:
Name of the author, shown above the content and used as the accessible name of the message. Without it,
nothing is shown and screen readers read "You" or "Assistant".
description.zh: 作者名称：显示在内容上方，也是消息的读屏名称。不传时不显示，读屏读「你」或「助手」。

description.en: Avatar of an assistant message, usually an Avatar with `size={28}`; shown to the left of the content.
description.zh: 助手消息的头像，通常是 `size={28}` 的 Avatar，显示在内容左侧。

description.en: Secondary information next to the name, such as the time or the model.
description.zh: 名称旁的次要信息，如时间、模型。

description.en:
State: `streaming` while the reply is generated (an empty reply shows "Generating" after 200 ms, actions are
hidden), `error` adds a failure note (with "Retry" when `onRetry` is set), `stopped` adds a "Stopped" note.
description.zh:
状态：`streaming` 生成中（还没有内容时 200ms 后显示「正在生成」，不显示操作）；`error` 追加失败说明（有
`onRetry` 时带「重试」）；`stopped` 追加「已停止」标注。

description.en: Explanation shown when `status` is `error`; "Couldn't generate a reply" by default.
description.zh: `status` 为 `error` 时显示的说明，默认「未能生成回复」。

description.en: Shows "Retry" in the failure note and calls this function when it is pressed.
description.zh: 在失败说明中显示「重试」，按下时调用。

description.en: Actions below the content, usually MessageActions. Not shown while `status` is `streaming`.
description.zh: 内容下方的操作，通常是 MessageActions。`status` 为 `streaming` 时不显示。

description.en:
When the actions are visible: `hover` on hover or keyboard focus (always on touch screens), `always` for
example on the last message.
description.zh: 操作何时可见：`hover` 悬停或键盘焦点进入消息时（触屏上始终可见）；`always` 始终可见，如最后一条消息。

examples.name: Basic

description.en:
The user message is right-aligned in a bubble; the reply is left-aligned with an avatar and a name, and its
actions appear on hover or keyboard focus.
description.zh: 用户消息靠右、在气泡中；回复靠左，带头像与名字，操作在悬停或键盘聚焦时出现。

examples.name: AlwaysVisible

description.en: `showActions="always"` keeps the actions of the latest reply visible, so they can be found without hovering.
description.zh: `showActions="always"` 让最新一条回复的操作始终可见，不需要悬停就能找到。

examples.name: States

description.en:
An empty reply that is still generating shows "Generating" after 200 ms. A failed reply keeps what was received
and offers "Retry"; a stopped reply is marked "Stopped".
description.zh: 还没有内容的回复在 200ms 后显示「正在生成」。失败的回复保留已经收到的内容并提供「重试」；被停止的回复标注「已停止」。

summary.en:
Actions under a message: copy, retry, like and dislike, plus your own icon buttons. Each button has a tooltip and
an accessible name; like and dislike are toggle buttons (`aria-pressed`) that exclude each other.

**Interaction**: the group is a toolbar with a single `Tab` stop: `←` / `→` move between the buttons, `Home` /
`End` go to the first and the last, and `Tab` leaves the toolbar; coming back, focus returns to the button used
last. Copying shows a check mark and announces "Copied" (CopyButton). Inside Message, the toolbar appears on hover
or when keyboard focus enters the message.
summary.zh:
消息下方的操作：复制、重试、赞、踩，以及使用方自己的图标按钮。每个按钮都有提示与读屏名称；赞、踩是互斥的切换按钮（`aria-pressed`）。

**交互**：整组是工具栏，只占一个 `Tab` 位置：`←` / `→` 在按钮之间移动，`Home` / `End` 到第一个与最后一个，`Tab`
离开工具栏；再回来时焦点落在上次使用的按钮上。复制成功显示勾并播报「已复制」（CopyButton）。放在 Message 中时，悬停或键盘焦点进入消息才出现。

usage.en: Copy, retry and rate an AI reply; actions of a chat message
usage.zh: 复制、重试、评价 AI 回复；聊天消息的操作

description.en:
The text copied by the "Copy" button, usually the plain text or Markdown source of the message. The button is
shown only when it is set.
description.zh: 「复制」按钮复制的文字，通常是消息的纯文本或 Markdown 原文。设置后才显示该按钮。

description.en: Called after the text has been written to the clipboard.
description.zh: 文字写入剪贴板之后调用。

description.en: Called when copying fails (see CopyButton); without it the error is reported with `reportError`.
description.zh: 复制失败时调用（见 CopyButton）；不提供时错误通过 `reportError` 上报。

description.en: Shows a "Retry" button that calls this function, for example to generate the reply again.
description.zh: 显示「重试」按钮并在按下时调用，如重新生成这条回复。

description.en: The current feedback (controlled). Without it the buttons keep their own state, starting with none.
description.zh: 当前的反馈（受控）。不传时按钮自己保存状态，初始为没有反馈。

description.en:
Shows the "Like" and "Dislike" toggle buttons; called with the new feedback. Pressing the pressed button again
clears it (`null`); the two buttons exclude each other.
description.zh: 显示「赞」「踩」两个切换按钮，以新的反馈调用。再次按下已按下的按钮会取消（`null`）；两个按钮互斥。

description.en: Accessible name of the toolbar; "Message actions" by default.
description.zh: 工具栏的读屏名称，默认「消息操作」。

description.en:
Your own actions after the built-in ones, usually IconButton with `size="sm"`. They take part in the arrow key
navigation.
description.zh: 内置操作之后使用方自己的操作，通常是 `size="sm"` 的 IconButton。它们同样可以用方向键切换。

examples.name: Basic

description.en:
Copy, retry, like and dislike. Like and dislike exclude each other, and pressing the pressed one again clears
it. The group has one `Tab` stop; `←` / `→` move between the buttons.
description.zh: 复制、重试、赞、踩。赞与踩互斥，再次按下已按下的按钮会取消。整组只占一个 `Tab` 位置，`←` / `→` 在按钮之间移动。

examples.name: CustomActions

description.en: Icon buttons passed as children come after the built-in ones and take part in the arrow key navigation.
description.zh: 作为子元素传入的图标按钮排在内置操作之后，同样可以用方向键切换。

summary.en:
A virtualized list of messages that stays at the latest message: only the visible messages are rendered (the
number of DOM nodes does not depend on the number of messages, and heights can vary), and new messages or a
reply that is still growing keep the view at the end. The height comes from the parent.

**Interaction**: it opens at the end. Scrolling up (wheel, touch, keyboard or the scroll bar) pauses following
and shows "Back to latest" at the bottom center, with the number of new messages; pressing it scrolls smoothly to
the end (it jumps when motion is reduced) and follows again, and so does scrolling back to the end. Earlier
messages inserted at the start (`onReachStart`) do not move the visible ones. The list can be focused with `Tab`
and scrolled with the arrow keys, `Page Up` / `Page Down` and `Home` / `End`. Screen readers are not interrupted
by every piece of a reply: the list is `aria-busy` while `streaming`, and the finished reply is announced once.
summary.zh:
虚拟化的消息列表，停留在最新的消息上：只渲染可见的消息（DOM 节点数与消息数量无关，高度可以不同），新消息与仍在增长的回复都让视图保持在末端。高度由父元素决定。

**交互**：打开时就在末端。向上滚动（滚轮、触摸、键盘、滚动条）会暂停贴底，并在底部居中显示「回到最新」与新消息数；按下后平滑滚到末端（减少动态效果时直接跳过去）并恢复贴底，自己滚回末端也会恢复。在开头插入更早的消息（`onReachStart`）时，可见的消息不会移动。列表可以用 `Tab` 聚焦，用方向键、`Page Up` / `Page Down`、`Home` / `End` 滚动。读屏不会被回复的每一段打断：`streaming` 时列表为 `aria-busy`，回复完成后读一次。

usage.en: AI chat conversations, long chat histories with earlier messages loaded on scroll
usage.zh: AI 对话、向上滚动加载更早消息的长聊天记录

description.en: The messages, oldest first.
description.zh: 消息，最早的在前。

description.en: Stable key of a message (such as its ID); keeps the position when earlier messages are inserted.
description.zh: 消息的稳定键（如消息 ID）；在前面插入更早的消息时据此保持位置。

description.en:
Renders a message, usually a Message. A message is rendered again when the item, its index or this function
changes: an inline function updates every visible message on each render, a stable function (`useCallback`)
must change when other data it reads changes.
description.zh: 渲染一条消息，通常是 Message。消息本身、它的位置或这个函数变化时重新渲染：内联函数在每次渲染时更新所有可见的消息；稳定的函数（`useCallback`）在它读取的其他数据变化时也要随之变化。

description.en: Estimated height of a message in pixels, used until it is measured.
description.zh: 消息的估计高度（像素），测量之前使用。

description.en: Number of messages rendered outside the visible area on each side (overscan).
description.zh: 可视区域两侧额外渲染的消息数。

description.en:
Set while the last message is being generated: the list is marked `aria-busy`, and when it turns off, screen
readers hear the finished message once (instead of every piece as it arrives).
description.zh: 最后一条消息生成中时设置：列表标记为 `aria-busy`；变回 false 时读屏读一次完成的消息（而不是逐段播报）。

description.en:
Called while the person scrolls near the top (within half the visible height), to load earlier messages.
Insert them at the start of `items`; the visible messages stay in place. Leave it out when there is nothing
more to load.
description.zh: 向上滚动到顶部附近（可见高度的一半以内）时调用，用于加载更早的消息。把它们插到 `items` 的开头，可见的消息位置不变。没有更早的消息时不要传。

description.en: Shows "Loading earlier messages" at the top and stops calling `onReachStart` while true.
description.zh: 为 true 时在顶部显示「正在加载更早的消息」，并且不再调用 `onReachStart`。

description.en: Shown when there are no messages, such as a welcome text with PromptSuggestions.
description.zh: 没有消息时显示，如欢迎语与 PromptSuggestions。

description.en: Accessible name of the list; "Conversation" by default.
description.zh: 列表的读屏名称，默认「对话」。

examples.name: Basic

description.en:
One thousand messages, of which only the visible ones are rendered. "Ask" adds a question and streams a reply
(a simulated endpoint read with useStream): the list follows the growing reply. Scroll up while it streams to
pause following; "Back to latest" brings you back.
description.zh: 一千条消息，只渲染可见的部分。"Ask" 追加一个问题并流式生成回复（用 useStream 读取模拟的接口），列表跟随增长的回复。生成时向上滚动会暂停跟随，「回到最新」回到末端。

examples.name: Empty

description.en: `empty` is shown while there are no messages, for example a welcome text with suggestions.
description.zh: 没有消息时显示 `empty`，如欢迎语与提示建议。

examples.name: LoadEarlier

description.en:
Scrolling up near the top calls `onReachStart`; the earlier messages are inserted at the start and the visible
ones stay in place. `loadingStart` shows the indicator meanwhile.
description.zh: 向上滚动到顶部附近时调用 `onReachStart`；更早的消息插到开头，可见的消息位置不变。加载期间 `loadingStart` 显示加载指示。

examples.name: Assistant

description.en:
The AI components together: the reply streams in as Markdown with citations, Reasoning shows the thinking step
before the first words arrive, Sources lists the references once the reply is done, and the latest reply can be
copied, retried and rated. The input stops the reply while it is generating.
description.zh: AI 组件的组合：回复以 Markdown 流式出现并带有引用，第一个字到达之前 Reasoning 显示思考过程，回复完成后 Sources 列出来源，最新的回复可以复制、重试和评价。生成时输入框可以停止回复。

summary.en:
The text field of a chat: it grows with its text, sends with `Enter` and turns its send button into a stop
button while a reply is generated. Files can be attached with the attach button, by dropping or by pasting
(`allowFiles`); they are shown as removable cards and handed to `onSubmit` with the text. The component never
uploads or reads the files.

**Interaction**: the field has a filled background; on focus it shows the accent border and the focus halo, like
Input. It grows up to `maxRows` lines, then scrolls. `Enter` sends, `Shift+Enter` adds a line break, and `Enter`
only confirms the text while an input method is composing. Sending is not possible while the text is blank and no
file is attached. While `generating`, the send button turns into "Stop generating" in place (same size, focus
kept), and `Esc` stops as well. Files dragged over the field show an accent drop area; rejected files are
reported with `onReject`; removing a card moves focus to the next card or back to the field. With
`disabledReason`, hovering or focusing the field shows the reason.
summary.zh:
对话的输入框：随文字增高，`Enter` 发送，生成回复时发送按钮变为停止按钮。允许附件时（`allowFiles`）可以用附件按钮、拖入或粘贴添加文件，文件显示为可移除的卡片，与文字一起交给 `onSubmit`。组件从不上传或读取文件。

**交互**：填充式外观；聚焦时显示强调色细边与光环，与 Input 一致。最多增高到 `maxRows` 行，之后在框内滚动。`Enter` 发送，
`Shift+Enter` 换行，输入法组字时 `Enter` 只确认文字。文字为空白且没有附件时不能发送。`generating` 时发送按钮原位变为「停止生成」（大小不变、焦点保留），`Esc` 也能停止。文件拖到输入框上时显示强调色的投放区；被拒绝的文件通过 `onReject` 告知；移除卡片后焦点移到下一张卡片或回到文本框。提供 `disabledReason` 时，悬停或聚焦输入框显示原因。

usage.en: The message field of an AI chat, prompts with attachments, any field that sends with Enter
usage.zh: AI 对话的输入框、带附件的提示输入、按 Enter 发送的输入框

description.en: The text (controlled). Clear it yourself in `onSubmit`.
description.zh: 文字（受控）。需要在 `onSubmit` 中自己清空。

description.en: Initial text (uncontrolled); the text is cleared after each submission.
description.zh: 初始文字（非受控）；每次提交后自动清空。

description.en: Called when the text changes.
description.zh: 文字变化时调用。

description.en:
Called with the text and the files when `Enter` or the send button is pressed. Not called while
`generating`, while disabled, or when there is neither text nor a file.
description.zh: 按 `Enter` 或发送按钮时，以文字与附件调用。`generating`、禁用时，或既没有文字也没有附件时不调用。

description.en:
A reply is being generated: the send button turns into "Stop generating" (`onStop`, also on `Esc`) and
`Enter` does not submit. Typing is still possible.
description.zh: 正在生成回复：发送按钮变为「停止生成」（`onStop`，`Esc` 也可以），`Enter` 不提交。仍然可以输入。

description.en: Called when the stop button or `Esc` is pressed while `generating`.
description.zh: `generating` 时按下停止按钮或 `Esc` 时调用。

description.en: Placeholder; "Type a message" by default.
description.zh: 占位文字，默认「输入消息」。

description.en: Accessible name of the text field; "Message" by default.
description.zh: 文本框的读屏名称，默认「消息」。

description.en: Disables typing, attaching and sending.
description.zh: 禁止输入、添加附件与发送。

description.en:
Disabled reason, shown on hover or keyboard focus while `disabled` (as on Button). With a reason, the text field
can still be focused (`aria-disabled`, read-only) and screen readers read the reason.
description.zh: 禁用原因：`disabled` 时悬停或键盘聚焦显示（与 Button 相同）。提供后文本框仍可聚焦（`aria-disabled`、只读），读屏读出原因。

description.en: Maximum number of visible lines; longer text scrolls inside the field.
description.zh: 最多显示的行数，更长的文字在框内滚动。

description.en: Allows attaching files: the attach button, dropping files on the field and pasting files.
description.zh: 允许添加附件：附件按钮、把文件拖到输入框上、粘贴文件。

description.en: The attached files (controlled).
description.zh: 附件（受控）。

description.en: Initial files (uncontrolled); the files are cleared after each submission.
description.zh: 初始附件（非受控）；每次提交后自动清空。

description.en: Called when files are added or removed.
description.zh: 附件增加或移除时调用。

description.en:
Accepted file types: comma-separated extensions and MIME types, such as `".pdf,image/*"` (as on Upload).
Every type is accepted by default.
description.zh: 接受的文件类型：逗号分隔的扩展名与 MIME 类型，如 `".pdf,image/*"`（与 Upload 相同）。默认接受所有类型。

description.en: Maximum size of one file in bytes. No limit by default; the server must check it as well.
description.zh: 单个文件的最大字节数。默认不限制；服务端同样要校验。

description.en: Maximum number of attached files.
description.zh: 附件的最多个数。

description.en: Called for each file that was not attached, with the reason.
description.zh: 每个没有加入附件的文件都会以原因调用。

description.en: Your own controls in the bottom bar, before the send button, such as a model picker.
description.zh: 底栏中发送按钮之前的自定义控件，如模型选择。

examples.name: Basic

description.en:
`Enter` sends and `Shift+Enter` adds a line break; the field grows with the text. The text is cleared after
sending (uncontrolled).
description.zh: `Enter` 发送，`Shift+Enter` 换行，输入框随文字增高。发送后文字自动清空（非受控）。

examples.name: Attachments

description.en:
With `allowFiles`, files can be chosen with the paperclip, dropped on the field or pasted. `accept`, `maxSize`
and `maxFiles` limit them; rejected files go to `onReject`. The files are handed to `onSubmit` with the text,
and the component never reads or uploads them.
description.zh:
设置 `allowFiles` 后，可以用回形针按钮选择、拖到输入框上或粘贴文件。`accept`、`maxSize`、`maxFiles` 限制文件，被拒绝的文件交给
`onReject`。文件与文字一起交给 `onSubmit`，组件从不读取或上传它们。

examples.name: Disabled

description.en:
`disabledReason` explains why nothing can be sent; the field stays focusable and shows the reason on hover or
focus.
description.zh: `disabledReason` 说明为什么不能发送；输入框仍可聚焦，悬停或聚焦时显示原因。

examples.name: Conversation

description.en:
PromptInput with MessageList and useStream (a simulated endpoint): send a message, watch the reply stream, stop it
with the stop button or `Esc`. The suggestions in the empty state send their label.
description.zh: PromptInput 与 MessageList、useStream（模拟的接口）配合：发送消息，回复流式出现，用停止按钮或 `Esc` 停止。空状态中的建议会发送它的标签。

summary.en:
A set of suggested prompts, each with a label and an optional description and icon; choosing one calls
`onSelect`. Use it in the empty state of a conversation or below a reply.

**Interaction**: every suggestion is a button with a neutral fill; hover and press add the shared state layer, `Tab`
moves between them and shows the focus ring, and `Enter` / `Space` choose. Disabled suggestions have a lower
opacity and do nothing; with `disabledReason` they stay focusable and show the reason on hover or focus.
summary.zh:
提示建议：一组建议，每条有标签，可带说明与图标；选择后调用 `onSelect`。用于对话的空状态或回复下方。

**交互**：每条建议都是中性填充的按钮；悬停与按下叠加统一状态层，`Tab` 在建议之间移动并显示焦点环，`Enter` / 空格选择。禁用的建议降低透明度、没有效果；提供 `disabledReason` 时仍可聚焦，悬停或聚焦显示原因。

usage.en: Starter prompts of an empty chat, follow-up questions after a reply
usage.zh: 空对话的开场建议、回复之后的追问建议

description.en: The suggestions.
description.zh: 建议。

description.en: Called when a suggestion is chosen with a click, `Enter` or `Space`.
description.zh: 用点击、`Enter` 或空格选择一条建议时调用。

description.en: `wrap` places the suggestions in rows that wrap; `vertical` stacks them in one column with the full width.
description.zh: `wrap` 横向排列、放不下时换行；`vertical` 纵向排成一列、占满宽度。

description.en: Accessible name of the list; "Suggestions" by default.
description.zh: 列表的读屏名称，默认「建议」。

examples.name: Basic

description.en: Suggestions in rows that wrap; choosing one with a click, `Enter` or `Space` calls `onSelect`.
description.zh: 横向排列、放不下时换行的建议；用点击、`Enter` 或空格选择时调用 `onSelect`。

examples.name: Vertical

description.en:
`layout="vertical"` stacks the suggestions with the full width, which suits longer texts. A disabled suggestion
with `disabledReason` stays focusable and explains why.
description.zh: `layout="vertical"` 让建议纵向排列、占满宽度，适合较长的文字。带 `disabledReason` 的禁用建议仍可聚焦，并说明原因。

summary.en:
The reasoning of an AI model before its answer: a header that shows whether it is still thinking or how long it
took, and the reasoning text, which can be expanded and collapsed.

**Interaction**: while `thinking` the content is expanded and the header shows a spinning loading indicator and
"Thinking"; when thinking ends, the header shows the duration ("Thought for 12s") and the content collapses.
Once the user expands or collapses it, it no longer changes by itself. The header is a button: hover and
press add the state layer, `Tab` shows the focus ring on the whole header, `Enter` / `Space` toggle it, and it
has `aria-expanded` and `aria-controls`. With "reduce motion" on, it expands and collapses without animation
and the indicator does not spin.
summary.zh:
模型回答前的思考过程：标题显示还在思考还是用了多长时间，下面是可以展开、收起的思考内容。

**交互**：`thinking` 时内容展开，标题显示旋转的加载指示与「思考中」；思考结束后标题显示用时（「已思考 12 秒」），内容自动收起。用户手动展开或收起过之后不再自动改变。标题是按钮：悬停、按下叠加状态层，`Tab` 聚焦时整个标题显示焦点环，`Enter` / `Space` 切换，带 `aria-expanded` 与 `aria-controls`。打开「减少动态效果」时展开、收起没有动画，加载指示不旋转。

usage.en: The thinking of reasoning models before an answer, the plan of an agent
usage.zh: 推理模型回答前的思考、智能体的计划

description.en:
The model is still thinking: a loading indicator and "Thinking" are shown, and the content is expanded.
When it becomes `false`, the content collapses (unless the user has expanded or collapsed it).
description.zh: 模型还在思考：显示加载指示与「思考中」，内容展开。变为 `false` 时内容自动收起（用户手动展开或收起过的除外）。

description.en:
How long the thinking took, in milliseconds, shown as "Thought for 12s". When omitted, the time between
`thinking` turning on and off is measured; when that is unknown too (for example a conversation opened again
later), the header says "Thought process".
description.zh: 思考用时（毫秒），显示为「已思考 12 秒」。省略时测量 `thinking` 从开到关的时间；也无法测量时（如之后重新打开的对话），标题为「思考过程」。

description.en:
The reasoning text, usually a StreamingText or a Markdown that streams in while `thinking`. It is shown in
the secondary text color.
description.zh: 思考的内容，通常是 `thinking` 期间流式到达的 StreamingText 或 Markdown。以次要文字色显示。

examples.name: Basic

description.en:
While `thinking`, the content is expanded and the header shows "Thinking"; when it ends, the header shows how long
it took and the content collapses. Here the thoughts stream in with StreamingText.
description.zh: `thinking` 时内容展开，标题显示「思考中」；结束后标题显示用时，内容自动收起。这里思考内容用 StreamingText 流式显示。

examples.name: Finished

description.en:
A finished reasoning with a known `duration` (in milliseconds) starts collapsed and shows the time it took; expand
it to read the thoughts.
description.zh: 已经完成、知道 `duration`（毫秒）的思考过程一开始就是收起的，标题显示用时；展开即可阅读。

summary.en:
The sources of an AI reply: collapsed to "3 sources" at first, and a numbered list with the title, the site and
a short description of each when expanded. The numbers match the inline Citation markers.

**Interaction**: the header is a button: hover and press add the state layer, `Tab` shows the focus ring,
`Enter` / `Space` expand and collapse the list, and it has `aria-expanded` and `aria-controls`. Titles with a safe
address are links (other sites open in a new tab with `rel="noopener noreferrer"`); addresses with other
protocols are shown as text. Remote site icons are never loaded automatically.
summary.zh:
AI 回复的引用来源：一开始收起为「3 个来源」，展开后是有编号的列表，每项有标题、站点与简短说明。编号与行内引用
Citation 的编号一致。

**交互**：标题是按钮：悬停、按下叠加状态层，`Tab` 聚焦显示焦点环，`Enter` / `Space` 展开、收起，带
`aria-expanded` 与 `aria-controls`。地址安全的标题是链接（其他网站在新标签页打开，带
`rel="noopener noreferrer"`），其他协议的地址显示为文字。不会自动加载远程网站的图标。

usage.en: Sources under an AI answer, search results that back a reply, the documents behind a summary
usage.zh: AI 回答下方的引用来源、支撑回复的搜索结果、摘要所依据的文档

description.en: The sources, in the order of their numbers (the first is 1).
description.zh: 来源，按编号顺序排列（第一个是 1）。

description.en: Shows the list expanded at first.
description.zh: 一开始就展开列表。

examples.name: Basic

description.en:
The list is collapsed to "3 sources" at first; expand it to see the numbered sources with their site and a short
description.
description.zh: 列表一开始收起为「3 个来源」；展开后是有编号的来源，带站点与简短说明。

examples.name: Expanded

description.en: `defaultExpanded` shows the list at once. Site icons are never loaded automatically: pass your own in `icon`.
description.zh: `defaultExpanded` 一开始就展开列表。不会自动加载网站图标：在 `icon` 中传入自己的图标。

summary.en:
Plain text that is typed out while it streams in: new text is revealed at a steady pace that follows the
arrival of the chunks, instead of appearing in blocks. Line breaks and spaces are kept. For replies that contain
Markdown use Markdown.

**Interaction**: not interactive. Text present when it mounts is shown at once; only text that arrives later is
typed out, and a character is never shown half-built (emoji, accented letters). While `streaming`, a static
cursor marks the end and the element is `aria-busy`. When the stream ends, the rest of the text appears at once.
With "reduce motion" on, the text is shown as it arrives, without typing.
summary.zh:
流式到达时逐字放出的纯文字：新到的文字按片段到达的节奏匀速显示，而不是一块一块地出现。保留换行与空格。包含 Markdown 的回复用 Markdown。

**交互**：不可交互。挂载时已有的文字立即显示，之后到达的才逐字放出，不会显示半个字（emoji、带附加符号的字母）。
`streaming` 时结尾有静止的光标，元素带 `aria-busy`。流结束时剩下的文字立即全部显示。打开「减少动态效果」时，文字到达即显示，不逐字放出。

usage.en: Streaming plain-text replies, generated titles and summaries, live transcripts
usage.zh: 流式的纯文本回复、生成中的标题与摘要、实时转写

description.en: The text received so far. It grows while the stream runs; line breaks are kept.
description.zh: 到目前为止收到的文字。流进行时不断变长；保留换行。

description.en:
More text is coming: the new text is typed out and a cursor is shown at the end. When it becomes `false`,
the rest of the text appears at once and the cursor goes away.
description.zh: 还有后续内容：新到的文字逐字放出，结尾显示光标。变为 `false` 时剩下的文字立即全部显示，光标消失。

examples.name: Basic

description.en:
Pass the text received so far and `streaming` while more is coming: new text is typed out at a steady pace and a
cursor marks the end. Line breaks are kept.
description.zh: 传入到目前为止收到的文字，还有后续内容时设置 `streaming`：新到的文字匀速逐字放出，结尾有光标。保留换行。

examples.name: Finished

description.en:
Without `streaming` the text is shown at once and there is no cursor, for example when a conversation is opened
again later.
description.zh: 不设置 `streaming` 时文字立即全部显示，没有光标，例如之后重新打开一段对话时。

summary.en:
A list of tool calls or steps of an AI agent, each with its state, and its input and output that can be
expanded. Use it for one call or for a chain of them; steps are connected by a line.

**Interaction**: the state of each step is an icon and a text ("Running", "Failed"), never color alone; the
running icon spins (not with "reduce motion"). Steps with an input or output have a header button: hover and
press add the state layer, `Tab` shows the focus ring, `Enter` / `Space` expand the details, and it has
`aria-expanded` and `aria-controls`. Details are collapsed by default and show the input and output in code
blocks with a copy button; long output scrolls inside its block. The reason of a failure is always visible.
summary.zh:
AI 智能体的工具调用或步骤列表：每步有状态，输入与输出可以展开查看。一次调用或一串调用都用它，步骤之间有连线。

**交互**：每步的状态是图标加文字（「进行中」「失败」），不只靠颜色；进行中的图标旋转（「减少动态效果」时不转）。有输入或输出的步骤，标题是按钮：悬停、按下叠加状态层，`Tab` 聚焦显示焦点环，`Enter` / `Space` 展开详情，带
`aria-expanded` 与 `aria-controls`。详情默认收起，输入与输出显示在带复制按钮的代码块中，长输出在块内滚动。失败的原因总是直接显示。

usage.en: Tool calls of an agent (search, file reads, API calls), multi-step tasks, background jobs of an assistant
usage.zh: 智能体的工具调用（搜索、读取文件、调用接口）、多步任务、助手的后台作业

description.en: The steps, in order.
description.zh: 各个步骤，按顺序排列。

examples.name: Basic

description.en:
Each step shows its state as an icon and a text. Steps with an `input` or `output` can be expanded to show them
as JSON; the reason of a failure is always visible.
description.zh: 每步以图标加文字显示状态。有 `input` 或 `output` 的步骤可以展开，以 JSON 显示它们；失败的原因总是直接显示。

examples.name: Running

description.en: Update `status` as the agent works: waiting steps, the running one with a spinning icon, then the result.
description.zh: 智能体工作时更新 `status`：等待中的步骤、正在进行的一步（图标旋转），然后是结果。

summary.en:
Runs a streaming request and accumulates its chunks into a value, such as the text of an AI reply. The stream can
be stopped and restarted; stopping, restarting or unmounting aborts the request. When chunks arrive densely
(hundreds per second), the value is updated at most once per animation frame.
Read the chunks with `readSSE` or `readTextStream`, or return any async iterable.
summary.zh: 发起流式请求，把收到的片段累积成一个值，如 AI 回复的文字。可以停止、重新开始；停止、重新开始、组件卸载时都会中止请求。片段到达很密集时（每秒数百个），值每个动画帧最多更新一次。片段用 `readSSE` 或 `readTextStream` 读取，也可以返回任意异步可迭代对象。

usage.en: Streaming AI replies, long-running generation with a stop button, any `text/event-stream` endpoint
usage.zh: 流式的 AI 回复、可以停止的长时间生成、任何 `text/event-stream` 接口

description.en:
Starts the request and returns the chunks, such as `readSSE(await fetch(url, { signal }), { signal })`. Pass
`signal` on to `fetch` and the reader: it is aborted when the stream is stopped, restarted, or the component
unmounts. The arguments after `signal` are the arguments of `start`.
description.zh: 发起请求并返回片段，如 `readSSE(await fetch(url, { signal }), { signal })`。要把 `signal` 传给 `fetch` 与读取函数：停止、重新开始或组件卸载时它会被中止。`signal` 之后的参数就是 `start` 的参数。

description.en: The value before the first chunk; `start` and `reset` return to it.
description.zh: 收到第一个片段之前的值；`start` 与 `reset` 都回到这个值。

description.en:
Folds a chunk into the value, such as `(text, e) => text + JSON.parse(e.data).delta`. Return a new value
instead of changing the old one. An exception fails the stream.
description.zh: 把一个片段并入当前值，如 `(text, e) => text + JSON.parse(e.data).delta`。返回新值，不要修改旧值。抛出异常时流失败。

description.en: Called with the final value when the stream finishes normally (not when it is stopped).
description.zh: 流正常结束时以最终的值调用（被停止时不调用）。

description.en: Called when the request or `reduce` fails, with the error and the value received so far.
description.zh: 请求或 `reduce` 失败时调用，参数是错误与已经收到的部分。

examples.name: Basic

description.en:
`request` returns the events of the response (here a simulated endpoint; in a real page, `fetch` with the same
`signal`). The text grows as events arrive; "Stop" aborts the request and keeps what has arrived.
description.zh:
`request` 返回响应中的事件（这里是模拟的接口；实际页面中用 `fetch`，并传同一个 `signal`）。文字随事件到达而增长；
"Stop" 中止请求，保留已经收到的部分。

examples.name: Failure

description.en:
When the connection breaks, `status` becomes `error`, `error` holds the reason and the text received so far is
kept. Arguments of `start` are passed on to `request`.
description.zh: 连接中断时 `status` 变为 `error`，`error` 是原因，已经收到的文字保留。`start` 的参数会传给 `request`。

summary.en:
An alert for persistent information on a page or in an area that needs the user's attention (warnings,
limits, next steps); `type` sets the meaning. For brief feedback on the result of an action, use useMessage
instead.
summary.zh: 提示条：页面或区域内需要用户注意的持续性信息（警告、限制、后续步骤），以 `type` 区分语义。操作结果的短暂反馈用 useMessage，不用它。

usage.en: Reminders that a feature is not configured, secrets shown only once, notes in a danger zone
usage.zh: 功能未配置的提醒、只显示一次的密钥、危险区域的说明

examples.name: Basic

description.en: Persistent information in an area that needs the user's attention; `type` sets the meaning.
description.zh: 区域内需要用户注意的持续性信息，`type` 区分语义。

examples.name: WithDescription

summary.en:
Root component of the application: provides the context for messages (useMessage) and danger confirmations
(useConfirmDanger), so that they use the current theme. Place it inside ThemeProvider at the outermost level and
wrap the application only once; a nested App uses the messages of the outer one, so there are never two stacks.
Messages are rendered at the bottom center of `document.body`, at most 3 at a time; they disappear after 4
seconds by default, and the timer pauses while the pointer is over them.
summary.zh: 应用根组件：为消息条（useMessage）与危险确认（useConfirmDanger）提供上下文，使它们继承当前主题。放在 ThemeProvider 之内、应用最外层，整个应用只包一次；嵌套的 App 沿用外层的消息条，不会出现两组。消息条渲染到 `document.body` 底部居中，最多同时显示 3 条，默认 4 秒后消失，鼠标悬停时暂停计时。

usage.en: Root component of the application; wrap standalone pages or tests that need messages or confirmations
usage.zh: 应用的根组件；独立页面或测试中需要消息条、确认框时包一层

description.en: Global settings of messages. Only applies to the outermost App: nested Apps use the messages of the outer one.
description.zh: 消息条的全局设置。只在最外层的 App 上生效：嵌套的 App 沿用外层的消息条。

examples.name: Basic

description.en:
Place it inside ThemeProvider at the root of the application; only components inside it can use useMessage
and useConfirmDanger. Messages appear at the bottom center of the screen.
description.zh: 放在 ThemeProvider 之内、应用最外层；其中的组件才能使用 useMessage 与 useConfirmDanger。消息条显示在屏幕底部居中。

summary.en:
Drawer that slides in from the right, for viewing details or editing longer content without leaving the
current page.

**Interaction**: when it opens, focus moves into the drawer and `Tab` / `Shift+Tab` cycle inside it; `Esc`
closes it, and focus returns to the element that was focused before opening.
summary.zh:
抽屉：从右侧滑出，在不离开当前页面的情况下查看详情或编辑较长的内容。

**交互**：打开后焦点进入抽屉，`Tab` / `Shift+Tab` 在抽屉内循环；`Esc` 关闭，关闭后焦点回到打开前的元素。

usage.en: Details and editing that keep the context of a list, such as member details, permission settings or conversation settings
usage.zh: 成员详情、权限设置、会话设置等需要保留列表上下文的详情与编辑

examples.name: Basic

description.en: Slides in from the right to show details while keeping the context of the list.
description.zh: 从右侧滑出查看详情，保留列表的上下文。

summary.en:
Empty state: an icon or illustration, an explanation and a call to action. Use it when a list has no data, a
search has no results or nothing is selected.
summary.zh: 空状态：图标或插画、说明与引导操作。列表无数据、搜索无结果、未选择内容时使用。

usage.en: Empty lists, searches without results, nothing selected in a split view, features not configured yet
usage.zh: 列表为空、搜索无结果、主从分栏未选择、功能尚未配置

description.en: Main text: why this place is empty, such as "No projects yet".
description.zh: 主文字：说明这里为什么是空的，如「还没有项目」。

description.en: Additional text: what the user can do next.
description.zh: 补充说明：下一步可以做什么。

description.en: Call to action, usually a primary button.
description.zh: 引导操作，通常是一个主按钮。

description.en:
An icon instead of the default illustration (easier to understand when it relates to the content, such as a
folder or a message).
description.zh: 用图标代替默认插画（与内容相关时更易理解，如文件夹、消息）。

description.en: Size: `md` for a whole page or a large area, `sm` inside lists and panels.
description.zh: 尺寸：md 用于整页或整块区域；sm 用于列表、面板内部。

description.en: Fills the height of the parent and centers the content.
description.zh: 占满父容器高度并居中。

examples.name: Basic

description.en: Explain why the area is empty and offer the next step.
description.zh: 说明为什么是空的，并给出下一步。

examples.name: Small

summary.en:
Error state: shown instead of the content when loading fails, with the reason and a way to retry. Never hide an
error behind an empty state or an empty table.
summary.zh: 错误状态：加载失败时代替内容显示，说明原因并提供重试。不要用空状态或空表掩盖错误。

usage.en: Failed requests for a list or details, lost connection to a service, missing permissions
usage.zh: 列表或详情请求失败、服务连接失败、权限不足

description.en: Title, "Failed to load" by default.
description.zh: 标题，默认「加载失败」。

description.en: Description of the error: a text readable by users, converted from the error; never show the raw exception.
description.zh: 错误说明：转换后的用户可读文本，不要显示原始异常。

description.en: Retry: when provided, a "Retry" button is shown.
description.zh: 重试：提供后显示「重试」按钮。

description.en: Size: `md` for a whole page or a large area, `sm` inside lists and panels.
description.zh: 尺寸：md 用于整页或整块区域；sm 用于列表、面板内部。

description.en: Fills the height of the parent and centers the content.
description.zh: 占满父容器高度并居中。

examples.name: Basic

description.en:
Replaces the content when a request fails and offers a retry. `message` is converted, user-readable text; do
not show the raw exception.
description.zh: 请求失败时代替内容显示，提供重试。message 是转换后的用户可读文本，不要显示原始异常。

examples.name: Small

summary.en:
Loading indicator: a centered spinner. Pages with a known layout should use PageSkeleton instead; use this one
only for short, local loading.

**Interaction**: stays invisible after mounting and fades in after 200 ms, so loads that finish quickly do not
flash an indicator; "stay visible for at least 400 ms once shown" is controlled with useDelayedPending. Not
interactive; screen readers announce "Loading".
summary.zh:
加载指示：居中的旋转指示。已知结构的页面优先用 PageSkeleton，只有局部、短暂的加载用它。

**交互**：挂载后先保持不可见，200ms 后才淡入，很快完成的加载不会闪出指示；「出现后至少显示 400ms」用 useDelayedPending 控制。不可交互，读屏读出「加载中」。

usage.en: Short loading inside drawers, dialogs and panels
usage.zh: 抽屉、弹窗、面板内部的短暂加载

description.en: Text for screen readers and the tooltip, "Loading" by default.
description.zh: 读屏与提示文字，默认「加载中」。

description.en: Fills the height of the parent and centers the indicator (loading a whole area).
description.zh: 占满父容器高度并居中（整块区域加载）。

description.en:
Shows the indicator immediately, without the 200 ms delayed appearance. Only use it when the indicator is
controlled by useDelayedPending and mounted only while that is true, so the delay is not applied twice (for
example when old data stays visible during a refresh, with the indicator on top of it).
description.zh: 立即显示，不做 200ms 的延迟出现。只在加载指示由 useDelayedPending 控制、在它为 true 时才挂载的场景使用，避免重复延迟（如刷新时保留旧数据、在上面叠加载指示）。

examples.name: Basic

description.en: Short loads inside a drawer or panel. After mounting it stays invisible and fades in only after 200 ms.
description.zh: 抽屉、面板内部的短暂加载。挂载后先保持不可见，200ms 后才淡入。

examples.name: Refreshing

description.en:
The old content stays in place during a refresh, and useDelayedPending controls the loading indicator: it appears
only after 200 ms and then stays for at least 400 ms. The indicator is mounted only while the hook returns true,
so pass `immediate` to avoid a second delay.
description.zh: 刷新期间旧内容保持不动，加载指示由 useDelayedPending 控制：超过 200ms 才出现、出现后至少 400ms。指示只在 hook 为 true 时挂载，所以传 immediate，不再延迟一次。

summary.en:
Dialog for a short task that needs the user's full attention (create, edit, confirm). Lay out the content with
Stack / Section. Confirm irreversible actions with useConfirmDanger; reversible actions run directly and offer
undo instead of asking for confirmation.

**Interaction**: when it opens, focus moves into the dialog and `Tab` / `Shift+Tab` cycle inside it; `Esc`
closes it, and focus returns to the element that was focused before opening.
summary.zh:
对话框：需要用户专注完成的短任务（新建、编辑、确认）。内容用 Stack / Section 排版。不可恢复操作的确认用 useConfirmDanger；可恢复的操作直接执行并提供撤销，不弹确认。

**交互**：打开后焦点进入对话框，`Tab` / `Shift+Tab` 在对话框内循环；`Esc` 关闭，关闭后焦点回到打开前的元素。

usage.en: Create and edit forms, confirmations, command palettes
usage.zh: 新建与编辑表单、二次确认、命令面板

description.en:
Flush content: removes the padding of the dialog, so the content lays itself out and follows the rounded
corners (such as the search field and result list of a command palette). Usually combined with
`title={null}`, `footer={null}` and `closable={false}`.
description.zh: 内容贴边：去掉对话框的内边距，内容自己排版并贴合圆角（如命令面板的搜索框与结果列表）。通常同时设置 `title={null}`、`footer={null}`、`closable={false}`。

examples.name: Basic

description.en: Put forms for creating and editing in a dialog; set `confirmLoading` on the confirm button while submitting.
description.zh: 新建与编辑的表单放在对话框中；提交中给确认按钮 `confirmLoading`。

examples.name: Flush

description.en:
`flush` removes the padding of the dialog so that the content lays itself out and fits the rounded corners, like
the search box and result list of a command palette.
description.zh: `flush` 去掉对话框的内边距，内容自己排版并贴合圆角，如命令面板的搜索框与结果列表。

summary.en:
Page skeleton: replaces the whole page while its data loads for the first time; its shape is close to the final
page, which reduces layout shifts.

**Interaction**: stays invisible after mounting and fades in after 200 ms, so loads that finish quickly do not
flash a skeleton; together with useDelayedPending, a skeleton that has appeared stays for at least 400 ms:
`if (query.isPending || showSkeleton) return <PageSkeleton />`. Not interactive.
summary.zh:
页面骨架：页面数据首次加载时代替整页内容，形状接近最终页面，减少跳动。

**交互**：挂载后先保持不可见，200ms 后才淡入，很快完成的加载不会闪出骨架；配合 useDelayedPending
保证骨架一旦出现至少显示 400ms：`if (query.isPending || showSkeleton) return <PageSkeleton />`。不可交互。

usage.en: First load of list pages, detail pages and split view pages
usage.zh: 列表类、详情类、主从分栏页面的首次加载

description.en:
Shape of the skeleton: `list` for list pages (title + list or table); `detail` for detail pages (title +
blocks of information); `split` for split view pages (list or navigation on the left + content on the right).
description.zh:
骨架形状：`list` 列表类页面（标题 + 列表或表格）；`detail` 详情类页面（标题 + 信息块）；
`split` 主从分栏页面（左侧列表或导航 + 右侧内容）。

description.en:
Shows the skeleton immediately, without the 200 ms delayed appearance. Only use it when the skeleton is
controlled by useDelayedPending and mounted only while that is true, so the delay is not applied twice.
description.zh: 立即显示，不做 200ms 的延迟出现。只在骨架由 useDelayedPending 控制、在它为 true 时才挂载的场景使用，避免重复延迟。

examples.name: Basic

description.en:
First load of a list page. It stays invisible after mounting and fades in after 200 ms, so fast loads do not
flash a skeleton.
description.zh: 列表类页面首次加载。挂载后先保持不可见，200ms 后才淡入，很快完成的加载不会闪出骨架。

examples.name: Split
WithDelayedPending

title.en: No flash: shown for at least 400 ms

description.en:
useDelayedPending keeps the skeleton visible for at least 400 ms once it appears, so slightly slow loads do not
flash by.
On first load, include `isPending` in the condition as well: the skeleton mounts as soon as loading starts, and
its own 200 ms delayed fade-in works together with the hook.
description.zh: 用 useDelayedPending 保证骨架一旦出现至少显示 400ms，稍慢的加载也不会一闪而过。首次加载把 isPending 也放进条件：骨架在加载开始时就挂载，自带的 200ms 延迟淡入与 hook 同时生效。

summary.en:
Popconfirm: a lightweight confirmation that pops up next to its trigger, for actions with a small impact that
still need confirming (such as removing one access grant). Irreversible actions such as deleting an object or
clearing data use useConfirmDanger.

**Interaction**: when it opens, focus moves to "Cancel" (pressing `Enter` does not confirm by accident); `Tab`
moves between "Cancel" and "Confirm", and `Enter` / `Space` trigger them; `Esc` closes it. After confirming,
cancelling or closing with `Esc`, focus returns to the trigger.
summary.zh:
气泡确认：在触发元素旁弹出的轻量确认，用于影响范围小、但仍需确认的操作（如移除一条授权）。删除对象、清除数据等不可恢复的操作用 useConfirmDanger。

**交互**：打开后焦点移到「取消」上（回车不会误确认），`Tab` 在「取消」「确认」之间移动，`Enter` / `Space` 触发；
`Esc` 关闭；确认、取消或 `Esc` 关闭后焦点回到触发元素。

usage.en: Removing a member, revoking access, deleting a draft row
usage.zh: 移除成员、撤销授权、删除草稿行

examples.name: Basic

description.en: For actions with a small impact that still need confirmation; irreversible deletions use useConfirmDanger.
description.zh: 影响范围小、但仍需确认的操作；不可恢复的删除用 useConfirmDanger。

summary.en:
Popover: a floating card next to its trigger with a title and richer content than a tooltip, such as details of
a person, a short form or a few actions. For a list of actions use Dropdown; for a confirmation use Popconfirm.

**Interaction**: it fades in from the side of the trigger. Opened by click (`trigger="click"`), focus moves to
the first focusable element inside it, or to the card itself; `Esc` or clicking the trigger closes it, and focus
returns to the trigger (when it is closed by clicking elsewhere on the page, focus stays on the clicked element).
Popovers opened on hover or focus do not move focus.
summary.zh:
气泡卡片：在触发元素旁浮出的卡片，带标题，内容比提示气泡丰富，如人员详情、简短的表单、几个操作。一组操作用 Dropdown，二次确认用 Popconfirm。

**交互**：从触发元素一侧淡入。点击打开（`trigger="click"`）时焦点移到其中第一个可聚焦的元素上（没有就移到卡片本身）；
`Esc` 或再次点击触发元素关闭，焦点回到触发元素（在页面别处点击关闭时，焦点留在被点击的元素上）。悬停、聚焦打开的气泡卡片不移动焦点。

usage.en: Details of a person or a file on hover, a short form next to a button, filters
usage.zh: 悬停显示人员或文件的详情、按钮旁的简短表单、筛选条件

examples.name: Basic

description.en:
Opens on hover, and on keyboard focus with `trigger={['hover', 'focus']}`; focus is not moved. The trigger must
accept mouse and focus events, such as Button, LinkButton or IconButton (layout primitives such as Inline do not).
description.zh: 悬停时打开，`trigger={['hover', 'focus']}` 时键盘聚焦也打开；不移动焦点。触发元素必须能接收鼠标与焦点事件，如 Button、LinkButton、IconButton（Inline 等布局原语不行）。

examples.name: Click

description.en: With `trigger="click"`, focus moves into the popover; `Esc` closes it and focus returns to the button.
description.zh: `trigger="click"` 时焦点移入气泡卡片；`Esc` 关闭，焦点回到按钮。

examples.code:
export function Click() {
  return (
    <Inline>
      <Popover
        trigger="click"
        title="Rename"
        content={
          <Stack gap={2}>
            <Input defaultValue="Website redesign" aria-label="Name" />
            <Inline gap={2} justify="end">
              <Button variant="primary" size="sm">
                Save
              </Button>
            </Inline>
          </Stack>
        }
      >
        <Button>Rename</Button>
      </Popover>
    </Inline>
  )
}

summary.en:
Progress shows how far a task has come, as a line (default) or a ring (`variant="circle"`); the value uses
tabular numbers. The fill color follows `tone` and the track is a lighter step of the same color, so the level
reads across the whole bar; `status` shows the result of the task. For loading without a known progress use
Loading; for one whole split into parts, SegmentedBar.

**Interaction**: the bar moves to the new value using the motion tokens (no animation with "reduce motion");
screen readers read it as a progress bar with its value, and the result with `status` (give it an
`aria-label`).
summary.zh:
进度条：显示任务进行到哪里，线形（默认）或环形（`variant="circle"`），数值为等宽数字。填充的颜色按 `tone`，轨道是同一颜色更浅的一级，整条都读得出程度；`status` 表示任务的结果。不知道进度的加载用 Loading；一个整体分成几部分用 SegmentedBar。

**交互**：数值变化时按动效令牌过渡（「减少动态效果」时不过渡）；读屏读作带取值的进度条，有 `status` 时一并读出结果（请提供 `aria-label`）。

usage.en: Upload and import progress, storage usage, completion of a profile
usage.zh: 上传与导入进度、存储空间用量、资料完成度

description.en: How far the task has come, in percent from 0 to 100; values outside are clamped.
description.zh: 进行到哪里，百分比 0–100；超出范围按两端处理。

description.en: Form: `line`, a bar with the value after it; `circle`, a ring with the value in the middle.
description.zh: 形态：`line` 线形，数值在后面；`circle` 环形，数值在中间。

description.en:
Size: for `line`, the thickness of the bar (4, 8 or 12 px; `sm` for list rows); for `circle`, the diameter
(48, 80 or 120 px).
description.zh: 尺寸：`line` 是线条的粗细（4、8、12px，列表行中用 `sm`）；`circle` 是直径（48、80、120px）。

description.en:
Color of the fill, for how serious the level is: `accent` for normal progress, `warning` and `danger` for a
level that needs attention (such as storage that is almost full), `success` for a good level. The track is a
lighter step of the same color. Ignored when `status` is set.
description.zh:
填充的色调，表示程度：`accent` 为一般的进度，`warning`、`danger` 为需要注意的程度（如存储空间快满了），
`success` 为良好的程度。轨道是同一颜色更浅的一级。设置了 `status` 时不起作用。

description.en:
Result of the task: `success` uses the success color and shows a check mark, `error` uses the danger color and
shows a cross, instead of the number; screen readers hear "60%, failed". When `status` and `tone` are both
omitted, it becomes `success` at 100%.
description.zh:
任务的结果：`success` 为成功色并显示勾，`error` 为危险色并显示叉，代替数字；读屏读作「60%，失败」。
`status` 与 `tone` 都省略时，到 100% 自动为 `success`。

description.en: Shows the value (or the result icon) after the bar or in the ring.
description.zh: 显示数值（或结果图标），在线条后面或环的中间。

description.en: Accessible name, such as "Upload of report.pdf"; screen readers read it with the value.
description.zh: 读屏名称，如「上传 report.pdf」；读屏连同数值一起读出。

description.en: ID of the element that names the progress bar, instead of `aria-label`.
description.zh: 为进度条提供读屏名称的元素的 ID，代替 `aria-label`。

description.en: ID of the root element.
description.zh: 根元素的 ID。

description.en: For tests: rendered as `data-testid`.
description.zh: 测试定位用，输出为 `data-testid`。

description.en: The root element (the element with the `progressbar` role).
description.zh: 根元素（`progressbar` 角色的元素）。

examples.name: Basic
